news.headline_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒本期公共卫生新闻动态
news.lead_zh: 本期基孔肯雅病毒新闻集中呈现以下动态。
key_findings_zh: 世卫组织发布了虫媒病毒疾病临床管理指南,包括基孔肯雅热、登革热、寨卡病毒和黄热病。世界卫生组织(WHO)以网络研讨会的形式报道了这一事件。 [news-aaa944e3c48991ee]
2024年至2025年,留尼汪岛爆发基孔肯雅热疫情,实验室​​确诊病例54,250例,初级保健咨询195,800人次,急诊科就诊近3,000人次。《公共卫生档案》评论的作者分析了该流行病的影响以及公共卫生准备的教训。 [news-6e498f54f675fdae]
哥斯达黎加西北部报告了基孔肯雅热 暴发,阿拉胡埃拉省和瓜纳卡斯特省发现了当地的 传播。欧洲疾病预防和控制中心 (ECDC) 报告 2026 年有 300 例病例,而 2025 年有 8 例。暴发 涉及外国游客中的感染。 [news-1a7512cd70317cd7]
基孔肯雅病毒 感染已在多个地点报告,包括法国大陆、留尼汪岛和厄瓜多尔。这些病例被定性为本地感染,其中包括一名从斯里兰卡返回后被感染的德国旅行者。 [news-1436a90e8f463e78]
引入了一个新框架,使用事件知识图和主题建模来跟踪基孔肯雅热 暴发 期间的舆论变化。该框架是在与 暴发 相关的微博帖子的单个数据集上开发和测试的。 [news-c821bd04e3297d39]

news.lead_en: This reporting window highlights the following Chikungunya virus news developments.
key_findings_en: WHO launched guidelines for the clinical management of arboviral diseases, including chikungunya, dengue, Zika, and yellow fever. This event was reported by the World Health Organization (WHO) as a webinar. [news-aaa944e3c48991ee]

A chikungunya epidemic occurred on Réunion Island from 2024 to 2025, with 54,250 laboratory-confirmed cases, 195,800 primary-care consultations, and nearly 3,000 emergency-department visits. [news-6e498f54f675fdae]

A chikungunya outbreak has been reported in Costa Rica’s northwest, with local transmission identified in Alajuela and Guanacaste provinces. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) reported 300 cases in 2026, compared to eight cases in 2025. The outbreak involves infections among foreign visitors. [news-1a7512cd70317cd7]

Chikungunya virus infections have been reported in multiple locations, including Mainland France, Réunion Island, and Ecuador. The cases are characterized as locally acquired and include a German traveler infected after returning from Sri Lanka. [news-1436a90e8f463e78]

A new framework was introduced to track public opinion shifts during a Chikungunya outbreak using event knowledge graphs and topic modeling. The framework was developed and tested on a single dataset of Weibo posts related to the outbreak. [news-c821bd04e3297d39]

papers.title: Predictors of chronic arthralgia after chikungunya virus infection: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chikungunya is an expanding global health threat, with chronic arthralgia representing the main long-term driver of disability. Although many studies have assessed post-chikungunya outcomes, evidence remains fragmented and contradictory. We aimed to identify reproducible predictors of chronic arthralgia (≥3 months) after laboratory-confirmed chikungunya and to distinguish stable prognostic signals from context-dependent associations. METHODS: We searched PubMed, Embase, Cochrane Library and BVS/LILACS from inception to 6 February 2026, without restrictions. Eligible studies compared participants with and without chronic arthralgia at follow-up and reported extractable baseline or acute-phase factors. Two reviewers independently screened records, extracted data and assessed risk of bias using QUIPS. Random-effects restricted maximum likelihood meta-analyses pooled odds ratios and mean differences, with subgroup analyses by follow-up window. PROSPERO: CRD420251169320. RESULTS: Of 1784 records, 29 studies were included, comprising 4108 participants: 1878 with chronic arthralgia and 2230 without. After harmonization, 22 predictors were meta-analysed. The most consistent associations were female sex [odds ratio (OR) 2.08, 95% confidence interval (CI) 1.77-2.46; I2 = 8.3%], comorbidity presence (1.99, 1.55-2.55; I2 = 0%) and high blood pressure (1.52, 1.13-2.04; I2 = 33.4%). In contrast, several acute-phase manifestations and treatment-related markers showed less stable, timing-dependent or study-sensitive associations. Overall risk of bias was high in most studies and moderate in the remainder. CONCLUSIONS: Chronic post-chikungunya arthralgia was most reproducibly associated with readily identifiable baseline host factors, rather than with a uniform acute-severity phenotype. These findings suggest that risk stratification should not rely only on acute symptom burden, and that pre-existing vulnerability may define a clinically important high-risk group. Point-of-care identification of patients with these characteristics could support prioritization of follow-up and resource allocation during outbreaks, inform post-outbreak surveillance and guideline development, and may guide future burden-based vaccination strategies in endemic settings.
authors: Lucas Bussiki Corrêa da Costa Kotecki
Mariana Bussiki Corrêa da Costa Kotecki

papers.title: Global stability analysis of within-host Zika virus–chikungunya virus co-infection with CTL immune responses
papers.abstract: We formulate and analyse a mathematical model for the within-host co-infection dynamics of Zika virus (ZIKV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), incorporating latently infected cells and cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL) immune responses. We establish the nonnegativity and boundedness of solutions. Using the next-generation matrix method, we derive the basic reproduction numbers (RZL) and (RCL) for the ZIKV and CHIKV submodels, respectively, and the overall reproduction number (R0L=max{RZL,RCL}). Invasion reproduction numbers, (RZL,inv) and (RCL,inv), are derived to characterise the ability of either virus to invade an established infection. Global stability of the equilibria is established using Lyapunov functions. We investigate three therapeutic protocols: antiviral treatment blocking viral entry, treatment reducing viral production, and IL-2 therapy enhancing CTL responses. Sensitivity analysis of (RZL) and (RCL) is performed, and numerical simulations support the stability results. Simulations indicate that combined antiviral and immune-based interventions suppress co-infection by reducing viral replication and enhancing immune-mediated clearance.

papers.title: Nanopore Sequencing for Chikungunya Virus: Principles and Application.
papers.abstract: Nanopore sequencing is transforming viral genomics through real-time, portable, long-read analysis of RNA and DNA. Unlike traditional short-read platforms, it detects nucleotide sequences by measuring ionic current changes as nucleic acids pass through nanoscale pores, enabling direct single-molecule sequencing and base modification detection. Its simplicity, flexibility, and capacity for ultra-long reads make it ideal for resolving complex genomic regions, structural variants, and full viral genomes. These advantages have accelerated its use in pathogen surveillance and outbreak response, especially in resource-limited settings. For chikungunya virus (CHIKV), nanopore sequencing allows rapid, culture-independent recovery of complete genomes from clinical and vector samples, enabling real-time tracking of viral diversity, evolution, and spread. Experiences from Ebola, Zika, and COVID-19 have demonstrated the power of portable sequencing, now applied to CHIKV monitoring. Advances in tools such as Guppy, Dorado, Minimap2, and Medaka enhance read quality, consensus accuracy, and downstream analyses. Despite challenges in basecalling and error correction, robust quality control pipelines ensure reliable results. Ongoing improvements in chemistry, flow cell design, and machine learning will further enhance fidelity and throughput, establishing nanopore sequencing as a cornerstone of CHIKV genomic surveillance and epidemic preparedness.

papers.title_zh: 纳米孔测序用于基孔肯雅病毒:原理与应用。
papers.source_body_en: Nanopore sequencing is transforming viral genomics through real-time, portable, long-read analysis of RNA and DNA. Unlike traditional short-read platforms, it detects nucleotide sequences by measuring ionic current changes as nucleic acids pass through nanoscale pores, enabling direct single-molecule sequencing and base modification detection. Its simplicity, flexibility, and capacity for ultra-long reads make it ideal for resolving complex genomic regions, structural variants, and full viral genomes. These advantages have accelerated its use in pathogen surveillance and outbreak response, especially in resource-limited settings. For chikungunya virus (CHIKV), nanopore sequencing allows rapid, culture-independent recovery of complete genomes from clinical and vector samples, enabling real-time tracking of viral diversity, evolution, and spread. Experiences from Ebola, Zika, and COVID-19 have demonstrated the power of portable sequencing, now applied to CHIKV monitoring. Advances in tools such as Guppy, Dorado, Minimap2, and Medaka enhance read quality, consensus accuracy, and downstream analyses. Despite challenges in basecalling and error correction, robust quality control pipelines ensure reliable results. Ongoing improvements in chemistry, flow cell design, and machine learning will further enhance fidelity and throughput, establishing nanopore sequencing as a cornerstone of CHIKV genomic surveillance and epidemic preparedness.
papers.abstract_zh: 纳米孔测序通过对 RNA 和 DNA 进行实时、便携式、长读长分析,正在改变病毒基因组学。与传统的短读长平台不同,它通过测量核酸通过纳米级孔时离子电流的变化来检测核苷酸序列,从而实现直接单分子测序和碱基修饰检测。其简单性、灵活性和超长读取能力使其成为解析复杂基因组区域、结构变异和完整病毒 基因组 的理想选择。这些优点加速了其在病原体 监测 和 暴发 响应中的使用,特别是在资源有限的环境中。对于 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV),纳米孔测序可以从临床和 媒介 样本中快速、独立于培养物恢复完整的 基因组,从而实现病毒多样性、进化 和传播的实时跟踪。埃博拉、寨卡和 COVID-19 的经验证明了便携式测序的强大功能,现已应用于 CHIKV 监测。Guppy、Dorado、Minimap2 和 Medaka 等工具的进步提高了读取质量、共识准确性和下游分析。尽管碱基识别和纠错方面存在挑战,但强大的质量控制流程可确保可靠的结果。化学、流动池设计和机器学习方面的持续改进将进一步提高保真度和通量,将纳米孔测序确立为 CHIKV 基因组监测 和流行病防范的基石。

papers.title: Overview of Chikungunya Virus Epidemiology, Biology, and Pathogenesis.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), an arthropod-borne alphavirus within the Togaviridae family, is transmitted primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus. The virus causes an acute febrile illness characterized by severe, often bilateral polyarthralgia, with potential progression to chronic musculoskeletal pain and rare systemic complications involving cardiovascular and neurological systems. CHIKV exhibits a spherical, enveloped virion (~70 nm) with T = 4 icosahedral symmetry, incorporating E1/E2 glycoprotein heterodimers that mediate receptor binding and membrane fusion. Its positive-sense RNA genome (~11.8 kb) encodes nonstructural proteins for replication and structural proteins for virion assembly. Replication occurs in cytoplasmic spherules, involving synthesis of genomic and subgenomic RNAs, followed by glycoprotein maturation and budding at the plasma membrane. Epidemiologically, CHIKV has expanded beyond Africa and Asia, with major outbreaks driven by adaptive mutations enhancing transmission via A. Since introduction to the Americas in 2013, the global incidence remains high, with >180,000 confirmed cases reported in 2025. Preventive strategies rely on vector control and vaccination; VLP-based vaccines (e.g., Vimkunya) show promise, while live-attenuated formulations face safety concerns. No licensed antivirals exist; current management is supportive, though investigational therapies targeting viral replication and immune modulation are under development.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),一种属于Togaviridae科的虫媒α病毒,主要通过埃及伊蚊(Aedes aegypti)和白纹伊蚊(Aedes albopictus)传播。该病毒引起一种急性发热性疾病,特征为严重的、常为双侧性关节痛,可能进展为慢性肌肉骨骼疼痛,并偶有涉及心血管和神经系统系统的全身并发症。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究概述了基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)的结构、生物学及系统发育。研究内容包括病毒的结构、复制机制及其全球传播情况。分析涵盖了CHIKV谱系及其相关疾病。
elements_zh.methods: 基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)具有球形、包膜的病毒颗粒(约70 nm),呈T = 4二十面体对称结构,包含介导受体结合和膜融合的E1/E2糖蛋白异二聚体。其正链RNA基因组(约11.8 kb)编码用于复制的非结构蛋白和用于病毒颗粒组装的结构蛋白。病毒复制发生在细胞质囊泡中,涉及基因组和亚基因组RNA的合成,随后是糖蛋白成熟和在细胞膜上出芽。
elements_zh.main_results: 自2013年引入美洲以来,全球发病率仍保持较高水平,2025年报告了超过180,000例确诊病例。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 从流行病学角度看,CHIKV已扩展至非洲和亚洲以外的地区,其主要传播模式由适应性进化增强其传播能力。预防策略依赖于媒介控制和疫苗接种;基于病毒样颗粒(VLP)的疫苗(如Vimkunya)显示出前景,而减毒活疫苗则面临安全性问题。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 目前尚无获批的抗病毒药物;现有管理措施为支持性治疗,但针对病毒复制和免疫调节的试验性疗法正在研发中。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据未报告局限性或证据强度。

papers.title: Protocol for Detecting and Sequencing Chikungunya Virus from Field-Collected Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Arboviral diseases represent a major public health challenge, especially in tropical regions where environmental conditions may favor the proliferation and spread of mosquito vectors. Thus, early and accurate detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in mosquito populations can be a valuable tool for effective surveillance of circulating variants and for identifying new viral introductions. Given the challenges of detecting arboviruses in field-captured mosquitoes, we describe an integrated workflow for CHIKV molecular detection and whole-genome sequencing. This protocol includes mosquito homogenization using a bead-based mechanical disruptor, RNA extraction using TRIzol reagent with minor modifications, molecular screening using CHIKV-specific RT-qPCR, and whole-genome amplification followed by sequencing on Illumina platforms. Despite the protocol being optimized for individual mosquitoes, it results in high-quality RNA suitable for both entomological surveillance and genomic analysis. As this protocol allows recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from mosquito specimens, it can serve as a basis for genomic epidemiology studies, enabling monitoring of viral diversity and lineage dynamics, and facilitating early detection of emerging variants to support timely and targeted public health interventions in endemic and at-risk regions.

papers.title_zh: 从野外采集的蚊虫中检测和测序基孔肯雅病毒的方案。
papers.source_body_en: Arboviral diseases represent a major public health challenge, especially in tropical regions where environmental conditions may favor the proliferation and spread of mosquito vectors. Thus, early and accurate detection of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) in mosquito populations can be a valuable tool for effective surveillance of circulating variants and for identifying new viral introductions. Given the challenges of detecting arboviruses in field-captured mosquitoes, we describe an integrated workflow for CHIKV molecular detection and whole-genome sequencing. This protocol includes mosquito homogenization using a bead-based mechanical disruptor, RNA extraction using TRIzol reagent with minor modifications, molecular screening using CHIKV-specific RT-qPCR, and whole-genome amplification followed by sequencing on Illumina platforms. Despite the protocol being optimized for individual mosquitoes, it results in high-quality RNA suitable for both entomological surveillance and genomic analysis. As this protocol allows recovery of complete CHIKV genomes from mosquito specimens, it can serve as a basis for genomic epidemiology studies, enabling monitoring of viral diversity and lineage dynamics, and facilitating early detection of emerging variants to support timely and targeted public health interventions in endemic and at-risk regions.
papers.abstract_zh: 蚊媒疾病是公共卫生领域的重要挑战,尤其是在热带地区,环境条件可能有利于蚊虫媒介的繁殖和传播。因此,对蚊虫种群中基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)进行早期和准确的检测,可以成为有效监测流行变异株和识别新病毒引入的宝贵工具。鉴于在野外捕获的蚊虫中检测蚊媒病毒的挑战,我们描述了一种集成的工作流程,用于CHIKV的分子检测和全基因组测序。该方案包括使用基于珠子的机械破碎仪对蚊虫进行匀浆,使用TRIzol试剂进行RNA提取(略有修改),使用CHIKV特异性RT-qPCR进行分子筛选,以及全基因组扩增后在Illumina平台上进行测序。尽管该方案针对单个蚊虫进行了优化,但仍能获得高质量的RNA,适用于虫媒监测和基因组分析。由于该方案能够从蚊虫样本中回收完整的CHIKV 基因组,因此可以作为基因组流行病学研究的基础,实现对病毒多样性及谱系动态的监测,并有助于早期发现新兴变异株,从而支持在流行和高风险地区及时、有针对性的公共卫生干预措施。

papers.title: Erlotinib in a once-daily high-dose oral regimen could mitigate Chikungunya virus titer in mice
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a re-emerging arbovirus that causes debilitating inflammatory arthritis, for which no approved antiviral therapy currently exists. This study investigated the potential of repurposing erlotinib, a tyrosine kinase inhibitor, as an anti-CHIKV agent. Erlotinib demonstrated promising in vitro antiviral activity, with EC 50 values in the low micromolar range and a favorable selectivity index. However, in vivo evaluation in C57BL/6 mice revealed pharmacokinetic limitations, characterized by rapid absorption and clearance, resulting in insufficient drug exposure under standard dosing regimens. Escalation to an intensive four-times-daily (QID) regimen successfully maintained plasma concentrations above the in vitro therapeutic threshold but led to significant body weight loss and failed to reduce viral titers or viral RNA levels in infected tissues. However, a once-daily (OD) regimen improved tolerability and significantly reduced footpad and serum viral titers relative to vehicle-treated controls. Notably, despite the lack of virological control in the QID regimen, erlotinib treatment reduced leukocyte infiltration and tissue inflammation in both treatment regimens, indicating a host-directed immunomodulatory effect. Overall, these findings highlight the critical role of dosing frequency in determining erlotinib's in vivo antiviral efficacy against CHIKV and suggest that once-daily (OD) administration may represent a more viable dosing strategy for further evaluation of erlotinib as a host-directed antiviral against CHIKV. Future strategies should also explore combination approaches with direct-acting antivirals to achieve more viral suppression and mitigation of disease pathology, as well as Structure-Activity Relationship (SAR)-guided scaffold optimization to improve in vivo pharmacokinetic profiles.

papers.title: Global patterns of genetic diversity and evolution in chikungunya virus E2 glycoprotein
papers.abstract: The E2 glycoprotein of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mediates host-cell attachment and entry and contains key antigenic determinants targeted by host immune responses. Variation in E2 can influence host interaction, immune recognition, lineage diversification, and epidemic fitness, it represents a biologically relevant target for assessing evolutionary pressures and epidemic dynamics. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, we performed spatial–temporal stratification and analysis to assess clustering patterns across lineages and regions using Fixation index test (Fst). Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CKIKV E2 lineages (negatively statistically significant Tajima D, Fu and Li’s D, and Fu and Li’s F tests, p -values < 0.05) supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites, notably codon 146 in the West African lineage, codons 220, 245, 247, and 254 in the Asian lineage, and codons 54, 56, 102, 145, 163, 177, and 350 in the East/Central/South/African lineage. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories. Haplotype network analysis highlighted distinct clustering patterns shaped by geography and epidemic waves, reflecting the persistence of lineage-specific signatures across regions. At the same time, reduced connectivity among recent outbreak strains point to more discrete intercontinental movement events, likely driven by human-mediated vector dispersal or travel-associated introductions. Collectively, these findings underscore the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein and its implications for viral adaptation and immune evasion.

papers.title_zh: 全球遗传多样性及进化在基孔肯雅病毒 E2糖蛋白中的模式
papers.source_body_en: The E2 glycoprotein of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) mediates host-cell attachment and entry and contains key antigenic determinants targeted by host immune responses. Variation in E2 can influence host interaction, immune recognition, lineage diversification, and epidemic fitness, it represents a biologically relevant target for assessing evolutionary pressures and epidemic dynamics. In this study, we conducted a comprehensive analysis of E2 genetic diversity using a dataset of sequences collected across regions, hosts, and epidemic periods. Diversity indices, neutrality tests, and haplotypes network analysis were applied to characterize evolutionary pressures acting on E2 glycoprotein. To assess the influence of geography, host, and time on viral population structure, we performed spatial–temporal stratification and analysis to assess clustering patterns across lineages and regions using Fixation index test (Fst). Nucleotide diversity varied considerably across time, with the pre-expansion period (pre-2004) showing the highest diversity (Pi = 0.085), while more recent outbreak periods exhibited comparatively reduced diversity (Pi = 0.012). Neutrality tests revealed signatures of both purifying and positive selection across the three CKIKV E2 lineages (negatively statistically significant Tajima D, Fu and Li’s D, and Fu and Li’s F tests, p -values < 0.05) supported by codon‐based analyses showing pervasive purifying constraint across the E2 gene but recurrent diversifying signals at lineage‐specific sites, notably codon 146 in the West African lineage, codons 220, 245, 247, and 254 in the Asian lineage, and codons 54, 56, 102, 145, 163, 177, and 350 in the East/Central/South/African lineage. Population structure analyses using Fst indicated significant genetic differentiation between regional populations, reflecting restricted gene flow and localized evolutionary trajectories. Haplotype network analysis highlighted distinct clustering patterns shaped by geography and epidemic waves, reflecting the persistence of lineage-specific signatures across regions. At the same time, reduced connectivity among recent outbreak strains point to more discrete intercontinental movement events, likely driven by human-mediated vector dispersal or travel-associated introductions. Collectively, these findings underscore the spatiotemporal evolution of CHIKV E2 glycoprotein and its implications for viral adaptation and immune evasion.

papers.title: Workflow for Long-Read Amplicon Sequencing of Chikungunya Virus Using Oxford Nanopore Technology.
papers.abstract: This protocol provides a comprehensive, step-by-step workflow for whole-genome sequencing of Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) using an amplicon-based strategy optimized for Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) platforms. The procedure includes detailed instructions for sample handling, viral RNA extraction, quality control, cDNA synthesis, multiplex PCR amplification, library preparation, sequencing, and primary bioinformatic processing. The protocol is designed to maximize reproducibility across laboratories and is suitable for genomic surveillance applications, including outbreak investigation and molecular epidemiology, even when working with low-to-moderate viral loads.

papers.title: Chikungunya virus live-cell reporter systems reveal cell-type-dependent antiviral responses to ribavirin
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) remains a significant global public health threat, yet antiviral discovery is limited by experimental systems that provide little mechanistic resolution and rely heavily on transformed cell lines of uncertain physiological relevance. Here, we developed complementary live-cell CHIKV reporter systems comprising a dual-fluorescent subgenomic replicon and fluorescent infectious viruses that enable real-time monitoring of distinct stages of the viral replication cycle. By coupling an nsP3-tagged reporter to genomic RNA translation and replication with a subgenomic reporter of structural gene expression, we achieved temporal resolution of early and late replication events in living cells. Functional validation using replication-defective and subgenomic RNA-deficient mutants confirmed that the system distinguishes between viral RNA replication and downstream structural gene expression. Application of these reporters revealed distinct antiviral responses across transformed and physiologically relevant human cell models. Ribavirin and the nsP2 inhibitor RA-0002034 potently inhibited CHIKV replication in transformed cell lines. Unexpectedly, ribavirin activity was markedly diminished in primary human skeletal muscle myoblasts and dermal fibroblasts, despite robust antiviral effects in commonly used screening cell lines. Mechanistic studies showed that ribavirin-mediated inhibition was rescued by guanosine but not inosine supplementation and was recapitulated by mycophenolic acid, consistent with guanine nucleotide depletion as the predominant antiviral mechanism under the conditions tested. Notably, inhibition through this pathway was substantially less effective in primary human cells. Together, these findings establish versatile live-cell CHIKV reporter systems for mechanistic studies of viral replication and reveal striking cell-type-dependent differences in response to guanine nucleotide depletion. Our results demonstrate that host-cell context can profoundly influence both CHIKV replication and antiviral susceptibility, highlighting the importance of physiologically relevant models for understanding virus-host interactions and antiviral mechanism.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 仍然是一个重大的全球公共卫生威胁,但 抗病毒药物 的发现受到实验系统的限制,这些实验系统提供的机械分辨率很少,并且严重依赖于不确定生理相关性的转化细胞系。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 在这里,我们开发了互补的活细胞 CHIKV 报告系统,包括双荧光亚基因组复制子和荧光感染病毒,能够实时监测病毒复制周期的不同阶段。
elements_zh.methods: 通过将 nsP3 标记的报告基因与结构基因表达的亚基因组报告基因组 RNA 翻译和复制相结合,我们实现了活细胞中早期和晚期复制事件的时间分辨率。
elements_zh.main_results: 这些报告基因的应用揭示了转化的和生理相关的人类细胞模型中不同的 抗病毒药物 反应。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 利巴韦林和 nsP2 抑制剂 RA-0002034 有效抑制转化细胞系中的 CHIKV 复制。出乎意料的是,尽管 抗病毒药物 在常用的筛选细胞系中具有强大的 抗病毒药物 作用,但利巴韦林在原代人骨骼肌成肌细胞和真皮成纤维细胞中的活性显着降低。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们的结果表明,宿主 细胞环境可以深刻影响 CHIKV 复制和 抗病毒药物 易感性,突出了生理相关模型对于理解病毒 - 宿主 相互作用和 抗病毒药物 机制的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 值得注意的是,通过该途径的抑制作用在原代人类细胞中的效果要差得多。总之,这些发现建立了用于病毒复制机制研究的多功能活细胞 CHIKV 报告系统,并揭示了鸟嘌呤核苷酸消耗反应中显着的细胞类型依赖性差异。

papers.title_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 活细胞报告系统揭示细胞类型依赖性 抗病毒药物 对利巴韦林的反应
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) remains a significant global public health threat, yet antiviral discovery is limited by experimental systems that provide little mechanistic resolution and rely heavily on transformed cell lines of uncertain physiological relevance. Here, we developed complementary live-cell CHIKV reporter systems comprising a dual-fluorescent subgenomic replicon and fluorescent infectious viruses that enable real-time monitoring of distinct stages of the viral replication cycle. By coupling an nsP3-tagged reporter to genomic RNA translation and replication with a subgenomic reporter of structural gene expression, we achieved temporal resolution of early and late replication events in living cells. Functional validation using replication-defective and subgenomic RNA-deficient mutants confirmed that the system distinguishes between viral RNA replication and downstream structural gene expression. Application of these reporters revealed distinct antiviral responses across transformed and physiologically relevant human cell models. Ribavirin and the nsP2 inhibitor RA-0002034 potently inhibited CHIKV replication in transformed cell lines. Unexpectedly, ribavirin activity was markedly diminished in primary human skeletal muscle myoblasts and dermal fibroblasts, despite robust antiviral effects in commonly used screening cell lines. Mechanistic studies showed that ribavirin-mediated inhibition was rescued by guanosine but not inosine supplementation and was recapitulated by mycophenolic acid, consistent with guanine nucleotide depletion as the predominant antiviral mechanism under the conditions tested. Notably, inhibition through this pathway was substantially less effective in primary human cells. Together, these findings establish versatile live-cell CHIKV reporter systems for mechanistic studies of viral replication and reveal striking cell-type-dependent differences in response to guanine nucleotide depletion. Our results demonstrate that host-cell context can profoundly influence both CHIKV replication and antiviral susceptibility, highlighting the importance of physiologically relevant models for understanding virus-host interactions and antiviral mechanism.
papers.abstract_zh: 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 仍然是一个重大的全球公共卫生威胁,但 抗病毒药物 的发现受到实验系统的限制,这些实验系统提供的机械分辨率很少,并且严重依赖于不确定生理相关性的转化细胞系。在这里,我们开发了互补的活细胞 CHIKV 报告系统,包括双荧光亚基因组复制子和荧光感染病毒,能够实时监测病毒复制周期的不同阶段。通过将 nsP3 标记的报告基因与结构基因表达的亚基因组报告基因组 RNA 翻译和复制相结合,我们实现了活细胞中早期和晚期复制事件的时间分辨率。使用复制缺陷和亚基因组 RNA 缺陷突变体进行的功能验证证实,该系统能够区分病毒 RNA 复制和下游结构基因表达。这些报告基因的应用揭示了转化的和生理相关的人类细胞模型中不同的 抗病毒药物 反应。利巴韦林和 nsP2 抑制剂 RA-0002034 有效抑制转化细胞系中的 CHIKV 复制。出乎意料的是,尽管 抗病毒药物 在常用的筛选细胞系中具有强大的 抗病毒药物 作用,但利巴韦林在原代人骨骼肌成肌细胞和真皮成纤维细胞中的活性显着降低。机制研究表明,利巴韦林介导的抑制作用可以通过鸟苷而不是补充肌苷来挽救,并且可以通过麦考酚酸来重现,这与测试条件下鸟嘌呤核苷酸消耗作为主要的 抗病毒药物 机制一致。值得注意的是,通过该途径的抑制作用在原代人类细胞中的效果要差得多。总之,这些发现建立了用于病毒复制机制研究的多功能活细胞 CHIKV 报告系统,并揭示了鸟嘌呤核苷酸消耗反应中显着的细胞类型依赖性差异。我们的结果表明,宿主 细胞环境可以深刻影响 CHIKV 复制和 抗病毒药物 易感性,突出了生理相关模型对于理解病毒 - 宿主 相互作用和 抗病毒药物 机制的重要性。

papers.title: Optimized Amplicon Strategy for Long-Read Sequencing of the Chikungunya Virus Genome.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense RNA alphavirus transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Its global circulation and significant public health impact underscore the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms driving CHIKV pathogenesis and transmission. Although robust molecular biology methods exist for CHIKV genome sequencing, a major limitation for surveillance and research is the inability to determine whether two nucleotide variations co-occur within the same viral genome when they are separated beyond the span of typical short-read designs. Here, we describe an optimized approach for processing CHIKV RNA samples that generates large amplicons suitable for long-read nanopore sequencing. This protocol enables amplification of the complete CHIKV genome in only two or three amplicons and facilitates detection of co-occurring nucleotide variations across 4-7.5 kb within the same molecule, thereby simplifying sequencing workflows and improving resolution in studies of viral evolution.

papers.title_zh: 用于 基孔肯雅病毒 基因组 长读长测序的优化扩增子策略。
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense RNA alphavirus transmitted to humans primarily by Aedes aegypti and Aedes albopictus mosquitoes. Its global circulation and significant public health impact underscore the need to better understand the molecular mechanisms driving CHIKV pathogenesis and transmission. Although robust molecular biology methods exist for CHIKV genome sequencing, a major limitation for surveillance and research is the inability to determine whether two nucleotide variations co-occur within the same viral genome when they are separated beyond the span of typical short-read designs. Here, we describe an optimized approach for processing CHIKV RNA samples that generates large amplicons suitable for long-read nanopore sequencing. This protocol enables amplification of the complete CHIKV genome in only two or three amplicons and facilitates detection of co-occurring nucleotide variations across 4-7.5 kb within the same molecule, thereby simplifying sequencing workflows and improving resolution in studies of viral evolution.

papers.title: Assessing the Vector Competence for Chikungunya Virus in Mosquitoes.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a human pathogenic, mosquito-borne virus (arbovirus), which is causing epidemic outbreaks among human populations in Africa, Asia, Europe, and South- and Central America including the Caribbean. The development of novel approaches to prevent mosquito transmission of the virus in the field requires a detailed study of CHIKV interactions with its mosquito vectors in the laboratory. In this chapter, we describe how to prepare Aedes aegypti mosquitoes for the infection with freshly cultivated CHIKV. We also describe quantitative and qualitative viral detection assays in mosquitoes based on plaque assays and the amplification of saliva samples in cell culture.

papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a human pathogenic, mosquito-borne virus (arbovirus), which is causing epidemic outbreaks among human populations in Africa, Asia, Europe, and South- and Central America including the Caribbean. The development of novel approaches to prevent mosquito transmission of the virus in the field requires a detailed study of CHIKV interactions with its mosquito vectors in the laboratory. In this chapter, we describe how to prepare Aedes aegypti mosquitoes for the infection with freshly cultivated CHIKV. We also describe quantitative and qualitative viral detection assays in mosquitoes based on plaque assays and the amplification of saliva samples in cell culture.

papers.title: Autochthonous chikungunya virus outbreak in Verona province, Italy, 2025.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), primarily transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, has increasingly caused autochthonous outbreaks in temperate regions, including Italy. In 2025, a local CHIKV outbreak occurred in Verona province, Veneto Region. We report the findings of integrated epidemiological, virological and entomological investigations. METHODS: In 2025, a dedicated surveillance protocol was implemented to assess local transmission of arboviral infections in Verona province, enabling early detection of a local CHIKV circulation. Following notification of the index case, investigations were conducted in accordance with the national and regional arbovirus surveillance plans, including comprehensive epidemiological, virological and entomological analyses. RESULTS: The index case was identified on 6 August 2025, with retrospective detection of the first case with symptom onset on 31 July; the primary case was not identified. As of 15 October, 69 cases were reported (62 confirmed, 7 probable), with a mean age of 55 years; 91.3% had identifiable epidemiological links, mainly clustered in two municipalities of the Verona province. Most cases (76.8%) occurred between mid-August and mid-September. The outbreak lasted approximately 15 weeks, from the end of July to the mid of October. CHIKV-RNA was detectable in whole blood and, less frequently, urine only within the first 5 days after symptom onset, with higher viral loads in blood. CHIKV-specific IgM antibodies were detectable from Days 4-5 and IgG from Days 7-10. A total of 225 Aedes albopictus specimens were collected, all testing negative for CHIKV. Phylogenetic analysis revealed a highly homogeneous, monophyletic cluster within the East-Central-South African genotype, closely related to strains from the 2024-2025 Réunion outbreak. CONCLUSIONS: This outbreak underscores the value of dedicated surveillance protocols for early detection of febrile/suspected arboviral cases, while also highlighting key vulnerabilities, namely, an undetected primary case and negative entomological findings, pointing to the need for lower testing thresholds and earlier, risk-based vector sampling.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景:基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 主要由伊蚊传播,在包括意大利在内的温带地区越来越多地引起本土 暴发。2025年,威尼托大区维罗纳省发生了一场当地的CHIKV 暴发。我们报告综合流行病学、病毒学和昆虫学调查的结果。方法:2025 年,实施了专门的 监测 方案来评估维罗纳省当地虫媒病毒感染的 传播,从而能够及早发现当地的 CHIKV 循环。通报指示病例后,根据国家和地区虫媒病毒监测计划进行了调查,包括全面的流行病学、病毒学和昆虫学分析。结果:首例病例于7月31日出现症状,并于2025年8月6日发现首例病例;原发病例尚未确定。截至 10 月 15 日,报告了 69 例病例(62 例确诊,7 例疑似),平均年龄 55 岁;91.3% 有可识别的流行病学联系,主要集中在维罗纳省的两个市。大多数病例(76.8%)发生在八月中旬至九月中旬之间。暴发从7月底到10月中旬持续了大约15周。仅在症状出现后的前 5 天内,全血和尿液(较少见)中可检测到 CHIKV-RNA,血液中病毒载量较高。在第 4-5 天可检测到 CHIKV 特异性 IgM 抗体,在第 7-10 天可检测到 IgG。共采集了 225 份白纹伊蚊样本,所有 CHIKV 检测均呈阴性。系统发育分析显示,南非中东部基因型内存在高度同质的单系簇,与 2024-2025 年留尼汪岛 暴发 的菌株密切相关。结论:该 暴发 强调了专用 监测 方案对于早期检测发热/疑似虫媒病毒病例的价值,同时也强调了关键漏洞,即未检测到的原发病例和阴性昆虫学发现,指出需要降低测试阈值和更早、基于风险的 媒介 采样。

papers.title: Surface Plasmon Resonance-Based Analysis of Ligand Binding Kinetics in Chikungunya Virus Drug Discovery.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an emerging arbovirus lacking widely effective antiviral therapies, highlighting the need to characterize molecular interactions essential for its replication and pathogenesis. Surface plasmon resonance (SPR) is a sensitive, label-free technique that enables real-time analysis of biomolecular interactions by detecting refractive index changes at a sensor surface. SPR provides precise kinetic and affinity measurements for protein-protein, protein-RNA, and protein-ligand interactions using minimal sample quantities and supporting high-throughput screening. In CHIKV research, it has been applied to evaluate antiviral compounds, antibodies, receptor binding, and viral protein complexes. This chapter outlines key methodological considerations, including ligand preparation, immobilization strategies, assay optimization, and kinetic analysis.

papers.title: RT-RPA-Assisted CRISPR/Cas12a-Based Isothermal Detection of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is transmitted through the bite of Aedes mosquitoes, specifically A. CHIKV belongs to the alphavirus with a positive-sense ssRNA genome of 11-12 kb size. The virus has been reported from various geographical regions across the globe. Chikungunya fever is an acute febrile illness, which, if left untreated, may develop into chronic arthralgia that may persist for several months or acute encephalitis syndrome. Therefore, early diagnosis of CHIKV is crucial to initiate prompt supportive treatment. Laboratory diagnosis of CHIKV typically relies on serological tests such as IgM antigen capture ELISA and molecular methods including RT-PCR or qRT-PCR. However, both these methods are not viable in peripheral settings. This chapter highlights recent advancements in molecular detection techniques for CHIKV, specifically isothermal detection methods that eliminate the requirement for complex instruments. The detection is facilitated by RT-RPA and CRISPR/Cas12a endonuclease. The assay offers advantages over existing methods such as rapid and early detection, and eliminates cross-over contamination, ultra-sensitivity, high specificity, and ease of result interpretation.

papers.title: Production of Viral Particles from a Chikungunya Virus Infectious Clone.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is a positive-sense single-stranded RNA virus, which poses challenges for its study and genetic manipulation. Because direct mutagenesis of viral RNA genomes is technically impractical, reverse genetics systems are essential tools for investigating viral biology. To enable such approaches, infectious clones containing a full-length cDNA copy of the viral genome are constructed. The cDNA is positioned under the control of a bacteriophage RNA polymerase promoter, allowing commercial RNA polymerases to use the linearized plasmid as a template for the in vitro transcription of full-length viral genomic RNA (gRNA). Importantly, positive-sense viral genomes serve as mRNAs for the translation of viral proteins in a cellular environment, meaning that these transcripts contain all the information required to initiate viral replication. Following transfection into permissive cultured cells, viral proteins are expressed, enabling genome replication and, ultimately, the recovery of infectious particles from the cell supernatant. Here, we describe a detailed procedure for generating CHIKV particles through plasmid linearization, in vitro transcription, and subsequent RNA transfection.

papers.title: Naked-Eye Visual Loop-Mediated Isothermal Amplification Method for the Rapid Detection of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) represents a significant global health threat due to its recent resurgence. This protocol highlights the use of capillary-modified visual loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) technology for the rapid detection of CHIKV. We employed Vero cells for virus propagation and utilized the MolPure Viral DNA/RNA Kit for nucleic acid extraction, successfully amplifying extracted viral RNA at 63°C for 25 min. The presence of CHIKV was indicated by a distinct yellowish-green color change, demonstrating the effectiveness and simplicity of this protocol. Our protocol underscores the potential of LAMP technology as a rapid diagnostic tool for CHIKV, enabling timely public health interventions.

analysis.summary_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) poses a growing global health threat, prompting the development of a rapid detection method. Researchers established an in vitro protocol using Vero cells to propagate CHIKV, extracted viral RNA with the MolPure kit, and performed loop-mediated isothermal amplification (LAMP) at 63 °C for 25 minutes. Detection relied on a distinct yellowish-green color change, confirming CHIKV presence and demonstrating the assay’s simplicity and effectiveness. The authors interpret this as a promising rapid diagnostic tool that could enable timely public health interventions. By offering a point-of-care, visual LAMP assay, the protocol has the potential to enhance CHIKV surveillance and outbreak response, especially in resource-limited settings. No limitations or evidence strength assessments were reported in the abstract.

papers.title: Plaque Reduction Neutralization Test Against Chikungunya Virus Using Liver Homogenate.
papers.abstract: We adapted the plaque reduction neutralization test (PRNT) to detect chikungunya virus (CHIKV) neutralizing antibodies in liver homogenates instead of serum. This approach enables serological investigation using tissues collected from animal carcasses as nonhuman primate ones, during arbovirus surveillance, expanding opportunities for CHIKV monitoring and strengthening epidemiological surveillance efforts.

papers.title: In Silico Drug Design of Chikungunya Antivirals: Using Consensus Methods for Virtual Screening.
papers.abstract: Structure-based virtual screening is an attractive strategy in drug design. It enables the selection of potential binders to target biomolecules with known molecular structures, providing a rational framework for studying their mechanisms of action and guiding further optimization. However, accurately predicting the free energy of binding remains an extremely challenging task, and the available tools only provide approximate estimates. In this context, one strategy to improve the predictive power of virtual screening and increase the probability of identifying true binders is to employ multiple docking algorithms and combine their results using a consensus method. In this chapter, we will describe a step-by-step methodology to perform this task. We will conduct a virtual screening using AutoDock Vina, AutoDock4, and LeDock, and then combine their results employing the Exponential Consensus Ranking algorithm. Finally, we will discuss possible extensions of this strategy, such as incorporating Molecular Dynamics simulations as an additional filter in the virtual screening or integrating the novel Artificial Intelligence-based methodologies into the consensus framework.

papers.title: Expression and Purification of nsP2 Protease of Chikungunya Virus.
papers.abstract: The nonstructural protein 2 (nsP2) of chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an essential cysteine protease involved in viral polyprotein processing and replication complex regulation. Biochemical and structural studies of nsP2 require the availability of highly pure and enzymatically active protein. In this chapter, we describe a straightforward protocol for the heterologous expression and purification of CHIKV nsP2 protease domain (nsP2pro) in Escherichia coli. The protein is expressed at low temperature as a His-tagged construct and purified under native conditions by immobilized metal ion affinity chromatography, followed by dialysis for buffer exchange. The procedure typically yields milligram quantities of highly pure (>95%) and active nsP2pro, and has been successfully applied to wild-type and mutant variants for enzymatic assays and inhibitor screening.

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了在大肠杆菌中异源表达和纯化 CHIKV nsP2 蛋白酶结构域的方案,重点是蛋白质的生产和分离。
analysis_zh.methods: nsP2 蛋白酶结构域在低温下表达为 His 标记构建体,并在天然条件下使用固定化金属离子亲和层析进行纯化,然后进行透析以进行缓冲液交换。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该程序通常会产生毫克量的高纯度 (>95%) 和活性 nsP2pro,并已成功应用于野生型和突变体的酶测定和抑制剂筛选。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 所述方法为获得活性 nsP2pro 提供了一种可靠且直接的方法,这对于进一步的生化和结构研究很有价值。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现支持开发用于研究 CHIKV 蛋白酶功能的工具,这可能有助于 抗病毒药物 疗法和诊断的设计。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于描述方案,并未报告其在临床或流行病学背景下的应用,这限制了其与公共卫生的直接相关性。

papers.title: Chikungunya Virus Infection in Paraffin-Embedded Tissue: Analysis of Histological Alterations and Viral Detection by Immunohistochemistry.
papers.abstract: Histopathological analysis of tissues infected with Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), including biopsy and autopsy specimens, can provide valuable insights into the pathogenesis of atypical and fatal cases. By examining tissue architecture and cellular alterations under the microscope, it is possible to identify patterns of injury, inflammation, and cellular degeneration. These morphological findings provide evidence of how the pathogen interacts with host cells and tissues. Moreover, immunohistochemistry may be performed in tissue sections for the detection of viral antigens. Importantly, this technique allows the characterization of diverse biologically relevant targets in tissue samples, such as distinct immune cell subsets, cytokines, and additional molecular markers. This is accomplished by the use of antibodies selected for their specificity toward the antigen of interest. In this chapter, we present a concise overview of how histological analysis and immunohistochemical approaches can enhance the understanding of CHIKV-associated pathological mechanisms.

This is important for identifying patterns of injury, inflammation, and cellular degeneration associated with CHIKV infection.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study analyzed histopathological changes in biopsy and autopsy specimens from individuals with CHIKV infection, focusing on how the virus interacts with host cells and tissues. It included a range of specimens to capture diverse pathological manifestations.
analysis.methods: The methods involved histological analysis of tissue architecture and cellular alterations, along with immunohistochemistry to detect viral antigens. These techniques were used to characterize biologically relevant targets such as immune cell subsets, cytokines, and molecular markers in tissue samples.
analysis.main_results: The study observed histological alterations indicative of CHIKV-induced injury, inflammation, and cellular degeneration in infected tissues. Immunohistochemistry confirmed the presence of viral antigens in these samples.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings highlight the utility of histological and immunohistochemical approaches in elucidating the pathological mechanisms of CHIKV infection. This provides novel insights into the virus's interaction with host tissues.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results can inform improved diagnostic methods and enhance understanding of CHIKV pathogenesis, which is critical for developing targeted surveillance and treatment strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to abstract-level descriptions and does not provide detailed statistical or experimental data. The evidence is moderate in strength due to the lack of specific numerical findings and comprehensive analysis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 感染组织的组织学改变和病毒检测,以更好地了解其在非典型和致命病例中的 发病机制。这对于识别与 CHIKV 感染相关的损伤、炎症和细胞变性模式非常重要。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究分析了 CHIKV 感染个体的活检和尸检标本的组织病理学变化,重点研究病毒如何与 宿主 细胞和组织相互作用。它包括一系列标本来捕捉不同的病理表现。
elements_zh.methods: 这些方法涉及组织结构和细胞变化的组织学分析,以及检测病毒抗原的免疫组织化学。这些技术用于表征生物相关目标,例如组织样本中的免疫细胞亚群、细胞因子和分子标记。
elements_zh.main_results: 该研究观察到了受感染组织中 CHIKV 诱导的损伤、炎症和细胞变性的组织学改变。免疫组织化学证实这些样本中存在病毒抗原。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果强调了组织学和免疫组织化学方法在阐明 CHIKV 感染病理机制方面的实用性。这为病毒与 宿主 组织的相互作用提供了新的见解。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 结果可以为改进的诊断方法提供信息并增强对 CHIKV 发病机制 的理解,这对于开发有针对性的 监测 和 治疗 策略至关重要。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于抽象级别的描述,不提供详细的统计或实验数据。由于缺乏具体的数值研究结果和综合分析,证据的强度中等。

papers.title: Assessing Chikungunya Virus Protease Activity and Pharmacological Inhibition Using the acc-CHIK 15 -dnp Fluorogenic Peptide Substrate.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus, a mosquito-borne alphavirus, poses a significant global health threat due to its rapid spread and lack of approved antiviral therapies. The viral nonstructural protein 2 protease (nsP2p) plays a critical role in processing the viral polyprotein to produce key viral enzymes, making it an attractive target for drug development. In this study, we describe the expression and purification of recombinant CHIKV nsP2 protease and establish a robust fluorogenic assay to measure its enzymatic activity using the acc-CHIK 15 -dnp peptide substrate. The assay enables real-time monitoring of proteolytic cleavage and provides a platform for evaluating small-molecule inhibitors. We present optimized conditions for protein expression in E. coli, affinity purification, and tag removal, achieving high-purity nsP2 protease suitable for biochemical characterization. Using this system, we also provide a robust protocol for determining IC50 values for candidate inhibitors. This work provides a reproducible methodology for high-throughput screening of CHIKV protease inhibitors, facilitating the discovery of potential antiviral compounds against chikungunya virus.

papers.title: Quantification of Chikungunya Virus RNA by Real-Time RT-PCR Assay.
papers.abstract: RT-qPCR is characterized by‌ high sensitivity, strong specificity, excellent reproducibility, and operational simplicity, ‌enabling‌ rapid quantification of viral RNA within a short timeframe. The real-time PCR system relies upon the measurement of a fluorescent reporter during PCR, in which the amount of emitted fluorescence is directly proportional to the amount of the PCR product in a reaction. Here, we describe the use of TaqMan® probe-based one-tube Real-time reverse transcription quantitative polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) for the detection and quantification of the Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) RNA.

papers.title: Determination of Chikungunya Virus Infectious Titer Using Plaque Assays.
papers.abstract: The plaque-forming assay is the gold-standard method for measuring infectious viral particles. In this technique, lytic viruses infect and destroy host cells, but their spread is restricted by a viscous overlay medium. As a result, new viral particles can only infect neighboring cells, leading to localized clear areas known as plaques, which become visible after staining the remaining living cells. The number of plaques reflects the number of infectious viral particles initially present in the sample and is reported as plaque-forming units (PFU) per sample volume. In this protocol, we describe step by step how to perform a plaque-forming assay to determine the concentration of chikungunya virus in a cell culture supernatant.

papers.title: Automated Counting of Chikungunya Virus-Formed Plaques.
papers.abstract: The cytopathic effect (CPE) is a key to understanding the pathogenicity of the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) and is useful for evaluating viral infectivity in vitro. The plaque assay, based on the CPE induced by viral infection, provides an infectious virus titer for test samples. Additionally, the assay is simple, quantitative, and cost-effective. Thus, the plaque assay remains the gold standard for determining the infectivity of CHIKV. However, manually counting of virus-induced plaques with the naked eye or under the microscope is often time-consuming and labor-intensive. Therefore, automated plaque-counting software would improve the consistency and efficiency of plaque counting. We recently developed plaQuest, a stand-alone Windows software that enables rapid, reliable plaque counting for CHIKV. In this chapter, we describe the basic procedure for detecting and counting the CHIKV-formed plaques in a 24-well plate.

papers.title: Medicinal fungal secondary metabolites as potential inhibitors of the Chikungunya virus nsP2 protease: an integrated computational study
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an emerging mosquito-borne alphavirus that causes millions of infections and severe arthralgia annually. Due to the lack of specific antiviral medications, analgesics and NSAIDs are used for symptomatic relief but are associated with potential hepatic, gastrointestinal, cardiovascular, and renal toxicities. This study investigated natural fungal secondary metabolites selected to target nsP2 protease (PDB ID: 3TRK), a key protein involved in chikungunya virus replication. 1830 fungal secondary metabolites were screened using intensive in silico approaches to identify potential nsP2 inhibitors. Based on their binding affinity, ADMET profiles, and post-docking MM-GBSA, HOMO-LUMO, and QSAR analyses, three lead compounds (MSIDs 000670, 001323, and 001565) were selected for further investigation alongside the control (Withaferin A). The 200 ns MD simulations provided insights into their stability, while DCCM, PCA, and post-simulation MM-GBSA analyses further supported their favorable dynamic behavior and binding stability. Among these candidates, MSID000670 (Erinacerin Q) and MSID001565 (Caputmedusin F) exhibited optimal ADME properties, reduced toxicity, higher binding scores, and a consistently stable MD simulation profile. Since these compounds are reported here for the first time as promising drug candidates, they need special attention in chikungunya antiviral drug development. However, experimental validation is needed to confirm their therapeutic potential.

elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 本研究调查了针对 nsP2 蛋白酶(PDB ID:3TRK)选择的天然真菌次生代谢物,nsP2 蛋白酶是参与 基孔肯雅病毒 复制的关键蛋白。使用强化计算机方法筛选了 1830 种真菌次生代谢物,以确定潜在的 nsP2 抑制剂。
elements_zh.methods: 根据其结合亲和力、ADMET 图谱以及对接后 MM-GBSA、HOMO-LUMO 和 QSAR 分析,选择了三种先导化合物(MSID 000670、001323 和 001565)与对照(Withaferin A)一起进行进一步研究。200 ns MD 模拟提供了对其稳定性的深入了解,而 DCCM、PCA 和模拟后 MM-GBSA 分析进一步支持了其良好的动态行为和结合稳定性。

papers.title_zh: 药用真菌次生代谢物作为 基孔肯雅病毒 nsP2 蛋白酶的潜在抑制剂:一项综合计算研究
papers.source_body_en: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) is an emerging mosquito-borne alphavirus that causes millions of infections and severe arthralgia annually. Based on their binding affinity, ADMET profiles, and post-docking MM-GBSA, HOMO-LUMO, and QSAR analyses, three lead compounds (MSIDs 000670, 001323, and 001565) were selected for further investigation alongside the control (Withaferin A). The 200 ns MD simulations provided insights into their stability, while DCCM, PCA, and post-simulation MM-GBSA analyses further supported their favorable dynamic behavior and binding stability. Since these compounds are reported here for the first time as promising drug candidates, they need special attention in chikungunya antiviral drug development. However, experimental validation is needed to confirm their therapeutic potential.

papers.title: Comparative analysis of serum antibody responses and immune landscapes in patients with acute DENV-1, DENV-2, and Chikungunya virus infections
papers.abstract: Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are major mosquito-borne arboviruses that increasingly co-circulate in tropical and subtropical regions, including southern China. However, the extent to which these viruses induce shared or distinct host immune responses remains poorly understood. This study aimed to comparatively characterize immune responses during acute DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV infections. Materials and methods A total of 80 serum samples were analyzed, including 65 samples from patients with laboratory-confirmed DENV-1 (n = 29), DENV-2 (n = 10), or CHIKV (n = 26) infections and 15 healthy controls.Viral RNA was detected by real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction. Virus-specific IgM and IgG responses were measured by Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay, and serum cytokines were quantified using a multiplex assay. Group comparisons used nonparametric tests, and associations among antibody responses, cytokine concentrations, and viral RNA levels were assessed using Spearman’s rank correlation. Multiple comparisons were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure. Results The three infections shared features of interferon-associated immune activation and relatively restrained systemic inflammation but exhibited distinct immune mediator profiles, characterized by differential inflammatory mediator and growth factor responses. After multiple-testing correction, cytokine–cytokine correlation analysis revealed both shared and infection-specific patterns of immune mediator covariation, with shared associations involving IL-9, TNF-β, CCL4, and CXCL1 across all three infection groups. Positive associations between pathogen-specific IgM responses and Ct values were observed across the infections, although the association was not statistically significant for DENV-2 after multiple-testing correction. IgG responses showed a similar association only in DENV-1 infection. Integration of cytokine and antibody profiles further revealed distinct immune association patterns: DENV-1 showed broader associations involving viral RNA levels, inflammatory mediators, and humoral responses, whereas CHIKV displayed a more restricted pattern centered on associations between inflammatory mediators and IgM responses. Discussion These findings reveal shared and distinct immune responses during acute DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV infections and provide a comparative framework for investigating virus-associated immune regulation during acute arboviral infections.

elements_zh.main_results: 这三种感染具有干扰素相关免疫激活和相对抑制的全身炎症的共同特征,但表现出不同的免疫介质特征,其特征是不同的炎症介质和生长因子反应。经过多重测试校正后,细胞因子-细胞因子相关性分析揭示了免疫介质共变的共享模式和感染特异性模式,所有三个感染组中的共享关联涉及 IL-9、TNF-β、CCL4 和 CXCL1。

papers.title_zh: 急性 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 基孔肯雅病毒 感染患者血清抗体反应和免疫状况的比较分析
papers.source_body_en: Introduction Dengue virus (DENV) and chikungunya virus (CHIKV) are major mosquito-borne arboviruses that increasingly co-circulate in tropical and subtropical regions, including southern China. However, the extent to which these viruses induce shared or distinct host immune responses remains poorly understood. This study aimed to comparatively characterize immune responses during acute DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV infections. Materials and methods A total of 80 serum samples were analyzed, including 65 samples from patients with laboratory-confirmed DENV-1 (n = 29), DENV-2 (n = 10), or CHIKV (n = 26) infections and 15 healthy controls.Viral RNA was detected by real-time reverse transcription polymerase chain reaction. Virus-specific IgM and IgG responses were measured by Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay, and serum cytokines were quantified using a multiplex assay. Group comparisons used nonparametric tests, and associations among antibody responses, cytokine concentrations, and viral RNA levels were assessed using Spearman’s rank correlation. Multiple comparisons were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure. Results The three infections shared features of interferon-associated immune activation and relatively restrained systemic inflammation but exhibited distinct immune mediator profiles, characterized by differential inflammatory mediator and growth factor responses. After multiple-testing correction, cytokine–cytokine correlation analysis revealed both shared and infection-specific patterns of immune mediator covariation, with shared associations involving IL-9, TNF-β, CCL4, and CXCL1 across all three infection groups. Positive associations between pathogen-specific IgM responses and Ct values were observed across the infections, although the association was not statistically significant for DENV-2 after multiple-testing correction. IgG responses showed a similar association only in DENV-1 infection. Integration of cytokine and antibody profiles further revealed distinct immune association patterns: DENV-1 showed broader associations involving viral RNA levels, inflammatory mediators, and humoral responses, whereas CHIKV displayed a more restricted pattern centered on associations between inflammatory mediators and IgM responses. Discussion These findings reveal shared and distinct immune responses during acute DENV-1, DENV-2, and CHIKV infections and provide a comparative framework for investigating virus-associated immune regulation during acute arboviral infections.
papers.abstract_zh: 简介 登革热病毒 (DENV) 和 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是主要的蚊媒虫媒病毒,它们越来越多地在热带和亚热带地区(包括中国南部)共同传播。然而,这些病毒在多大程度上诱导共享或不同的 宿主 免疫应答 仍然知之甚少。本研究旨在比较急性 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 CHIKV 感染期间 免疫应答 的特征。材料与方法 总共分析了 80 份血清样本,其中 65 份来自实验室确诊的 DENV-1 (n = 29)、DENV-2 (n = 10) 或 CHIKV (n = 26) 感染患者和 15 名健康对照。通过实时逆转录聚合酶链反应检测病毒 RNA。通过酶联免疫吸附测定法测量病毒特异性 IgM 和 IgG 反应,并使用多重测定法对血清细胞因子进行定量。组间比较使用非参数检验,并使用 Spearman 等级相关性评估抗体反应、细胞因子浓度和病毒 RNA 水平之间的关联。使用 Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) 程序调整多重比较。结果三种感染具有干扰素相关免疫激活和相对抑制的全身炎症的共同特征,但表现出不同的免疫介质特征,其特征是不同的炎症介质和生长因子反应。经过多重测试校正后,细胞因子-细胞因子相关性分析揭示了免疫介质共变的共享模式和感染特异性模式,所有三个感染组中的共享关联涉及 IL-9、TNF-β、CCL4 和 CXCL1。在感染过程中观察到病原体特异性 IgM 反应与 Ct 值之间的正相关性,尽管经过多重测试校正后,DENV-2 的相关性并不具有统计学意义。IgG 反应仅在 DENV-1 感染中显示出类似的关联。细胞因子和抗体谱的整合进一步揭示了不同的免疫关联模式:DENV-1 显示出更广泛的关联,涉及病毒 RNA 水平、炎症介质和体液反应,而 CHIKV 显示出更有限的模式,集中在炎症介质和 IgM 反应之间的关联。讨论 这些发现揭示了急性 DENV-1、DENV-2 和 CHIKV 感染期间共有和不同的 免疫应答,并为研究急性虫媒病毒感染期间病毒相关的免疫调节提供了比较框架。

papers.title: Impacto epidemiológico del dengue y del chikungunya en zonas urbanas: revisión sistemática Epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas: a systematic review
papers.abstract: Objetivo: sintetizar la evidencia sobre el impacto epidemiológico urbano del dengue y del chikungunya. Método: revisión sistemática con síntesis narrativa en PubMed y SciELO (2012-2025); se incluyeron 15 estudios. Resultados: la incidencia mundial del dengue aumentó desde 1990, con diferencias regionales marcadas y alta carga en América Latina. El chikungunya se expandió por las Américas desde 2013 y produjo brotes urbanos explosivos, con manifestaciones articulares persistentes. La urbanización, la expansión de Aedes aegypti y Aedes albopictus y la resistencia a insecticidas favorecieron la transmisión. Destacan como estrategias las nuevas vacunas y el control vectorial integrado. Conclusión: ambas arbovirosis son una carga creciente para las ciudades tropicales y subtropicales y exigen vigilancia y control sostenidos.

analysis.summary_en: This systematic review synthesizes the epidemiological impact of dengue and chikungunya in urban areas, focusing on the spread and burden of these diseases. The review included 15 studies from PubMed and SciELO between 2012 and 2025. Key findings indicate that dengue incidence has increased globally since 1990, with significant regional variations and a high burden in Latin America. Chikungunya expanded across the Americas since 2013, causing explosive urban outbreaks and persistent joint manifestations. Urbanization, the spread of Aedes species, and insecticide resistance are identified as factors that facilitate transmission. The review highlights the need for new vaccines and integrated vector control strategies to address the growing public health challenge posed by these arboviruses in tropical and subtropical cities.

papers.full_text: Abstract Chikungunya, a mosquito-borne viral disease caused by Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), infects humans through the bite of Aedes sp. mosquitoes, causing high fever. Diagnosis includes the detection of IgM antibodies against CHIKV by ELISA. Department of Health Research (DHR)—Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) implemented an External Quality Assurance Scheme (EQAS) through Proficiency Testing (PT) to ensure the accuracy and reliability of CHIKV-IgM-ELISA testing across a network of laboratories in India. The geographical distribution of the participant laboratories from the PT provider (PTP) can lead to delayed transportation while distributing the PT panels, which could result in disqualification of PT panels due to suspected sample degradation and thus necessitates expensive panel redistributions. This study evaluated panel quality by assessing homogeneity and stability across various temperatures and time periods that simulate real-world transit conditions. The results were analyzed in accordance with ISO 13528:2022. This study shows that the CHIKV-positive samples in the PT panel remained robust across all tested temperature ranges and time periods, maintaining 100% qualitative concordance for up to 168 h and at a maximum temperature of 45 °C. Therefore, we conclude that the PT panels sent for EQA for the qualitative Chikungunya IgM ELISA test will be suitable for testing at the participant laboratories when received within a time duration of 168 h with a maximum transit temperature of 45 °C. Thus, the rejection of panels due to suspected sample degradation and expensive panel redistribution can be avoided. Data availability No datasets were generated or analyzed during the current study. papers.title_original: Homogeneity and stability evaluation of EQA serum samples for Chikungunya IgM ELISA

analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to evaluate the homogeneity and stability of external quality assurance (EQA) serum samples for Chikungunya IgM ELISA to address the challenge of sample degradation during transit, which could affect diagnostic accuracy.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study was conducted by the Department of Health Research (DHR)—Indian Council of Medical Research (ICMR) through an External Quality Assurance Scheme (EQAS) using proficiency testing (PT) panels distributed to a network of laboratories in India. The participant laboratories were involved in testing the CHIKV-positive samples under simulated real-world transit conditions.
analysis.methods: The homogeneity and stability of the EQA serum samples were assessed by simulating various temperature ranges and time periods that mimic real-world transportation conditions. The evaluation followed the guidelines outlined in ISO 13528:2022.
analysis.main_results: The CHIKV-positive samples in the PT panel remained robust across all tested temperature ranges and time periods, maintaining 100% qualitative concordance for up to 168 h and at a maximum temperature of 45 °C.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted the results as demonstrating that the PT panels can be reliably used for EQA of Chikungunya IgM ELISA tests if received within 168 h and under a maximum transit temperature of 45 °C, which is a novel finding for ensuring the reliability of such testing in field conditions.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings provide specific guidance for the reliable use of EQA serum samples in Chikungunya IgM ELISA testing, which can inform the design of quality assurance programs and reduce the risk of sample disqualification due to degradation during transit.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited by its reliance on leftover, de-identified samples, which may affect the generalizability of results. The evidence is strong, as it is based on direct testing under simulated conditions and analyzed according to ISO 13528:2022 standards.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the homogeneity and stability of EQA serum samples for Chikungunya IgM ELISA under simulated real-world transit conditions. The research aimed to address the issue of sample degradation during transportation, which could lead to the disqualification of PT panels and necessitate costly redistributions. The study found that CHIKV-positive samples remained robust across all tested temperature ranges and time periods, maintaining 100% qualitative concordance for up to 168 hours at a maximum temperature of 45°C. These results suggest that the PT panels can be reliably used for EQA if received within these parameters, offering specific guidance for quality assurance programs. The study was conducted using leftover, de-identified samples, which may limit generalizability, but the findings are supported by ISO 13528:2022 standards, indicating strong evidence. The results have implications for improving the reliability of serological testing in field settings and reducing logistical challenges in quality assurance schemes.

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究讨论了 IXCHIQ 基孔肯雅病毒 疫苗 在安全审查后从英国市场撤出的问题。该研究旨在为有关 疫苗 安全性和有效性的公共卫生和监管决策提供信息。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及对在英国进行的 IXCHIQ 基孔肯雅 疫苗 的安全数据的审查。该审查基于上市后 监测 数据和安全报告。
analysis_zh.methods: 这些方法包括对上市后 监测 的安全数据和安全报告进行审查。没有进行特定的采样、测定或统计分析。
analysis_zh.main_results: 结果表明,由于 监测 上市后发现的安全问题,IXCHIQ 基孔肯雅 疫苗 已从英国市场撤出。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将研究结果解释为表明需要对 疫苗 进行持续的安全监测,并强调在 疫苗 批准之前和之后进行彻底安全审查的重要性。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果警告不要在英国使用 IXCHIQ 基孔肯雅 疫苗,并强调 疫苗 持续安全的重要性。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括依赖上市后 监测 数据以及缺乏具体的方法细节。由于该研究的观察性质,证据强度中等。

papers.title: Global Genomic Surveillance.
papers.abstract: Global genomic surveillance has emerged as a foundational pillar of public health in the twenty-first century, enabling real-time tracking of pathogen evolution and informing outbreak response. This chapter examines the strategic architecture of global genomic surveillance, focusing on its application to arboviruses such as chikungunya virus (CHIKV). It explores the integration of genomic data with epidemiological, clinical, and environmental information within a One Health framework, while addressing critical challenges in governance, equity, and interoperability. The discussion covers the entire genomic surveillance workflow, from sample collection and sequencing to bioinformatic analysis and phylogenetic inference, and highlights the transformative role of artificial intelligence (AI) in predictive surveillance. By analyzing global initiatives, operational barriers, and emerging technologies, this chapter underscores the necessity of sustainable, equitable, and interoperable genomic systems to proactively address current and future infectious disease threats.

papers.title: Dissection of Aedes albopictus and Total RNA Extraction from Post-Dissection Tissues.
papers.abstract: In Foshan, Guangdong Province, China, in July 2025, an outbreak of dengue fever and chikungunya occurred. albopictus is a major vector for these viruses. This protocol describes a simple, standardized method for dissecting the midgut, salivary glands, and ovaries of Ae. albopictus and extracting total RNA from the dissected tissues. Three-day-old non-blood-fed female mosquitoes were anesthetized by freezing at -20 °C for 2 min, after which the target tissues were dissected. Total RNA was extracted with a tissue RNA extraction kit, quantified by a microvolume spectrophotometer, and used for quantitative real-time polymerase chain reaction (RT-qPCR) analysis. The results show that the dissection method rapidly and completely separates the tissues, and that RNA from the separated tissues can achieve relatively high purity. RT-qPCR demonstrated the expression patterns and relative stability of three reference genes (GAPDH, β-actin, and RPS6). The method is straightforward, validated, and provides standardized technical support for Ae. albopictus related research.

papers.title: Solanaceae-Derived Spirostane Saponins Inhibit Dengue Virus Replication and Viral Protein Expression and Exhibit Activity Against Multiple Arboviruses.
papers.abstract: Mosquito-borne arboviruses, including dengue virus (DENV), Zika virus (ZIKV), and chikungunya virus (CHIKV), represent a growing global health burden, yet no specific antiviral therapies are currently available for most of these infections. This unmet need highlights the importance of identifying novel antiviral compounds from biologically relevant sources such as plant-derived natural products. In this study, a bioactivity-guided approach was applied to methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species to identify compounds with antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells. Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Subsequent fractionation and purification led to the isolation of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, structurally characterized by UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy. Functional assays demonstrated that these compounds inhibit DENV replication, as evidenced by marked reductions in viral RNA levels, NS1 and NS3 protein expression, and infectious viral titers. Stage-specific analyses revealed that their antiviral activity is primarily associated with intracellular phases of the viral life cycle, consistent with inhibition of viral replication and/or protein processing. Molecular docking analyses supported these findings by predicting favorable interactions with key viral enzymes, particularly NS5 RNA-dependent RNA polymerase and NS3 helicase/protease. Importantly, the isolated compounds retained antiviral activity against ZIKV and CHIKV, indicating cross-arboviral efficacy. Together, these findings identify spirostane saponins as promising antiviral scaffolds and support their further development as broad-spectrum antiviral agents.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the lack of specific antiviral therapies for mosquito-borne arboviruses, including chikungunya virus, by exploring novel compounds from plant sources.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed a bioactivity-guided approach to screen methanolic extracts from eight Solanaceae species for antiviral activity against DENV-2 in Vero cells, with a focus on chikungunya virus.
analysis.methods: The researchers used bioactivity-guided screening, fractionation, and purification techniques to isolate compounds, followed by structural characterization using UPLC-DAD-MS and 1D/2D NMR spectroscopy, and functional assays to assess antiviral activity.
analysis.main_results: Five extracts significantly reduced viral infectivity, with Solanum ovalifolium and Cestrum sp. achieving complete inhibition at non-cytotoxic concentrations. Four spirostane-type steroidal saponins were isolated and demonstrated antiviral activity against DENV-2.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The findings suggest that spirostane saponins could serve as promising antiviral scaffolds, offering potential for the development of broad-spectrum antiviral agents against multiple arboviruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The results provide a foundation for further research into plant-derived compounds as therapeutic options for chikungunya virus and other related arboviruses, potentially contributing to surveillance and treatment strategies.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to in vitro findings and does not address in vivo efficacy or clinical translation, which reduces the strength of the evidence to moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study investigates the potential of Solanaceae-derived spirostane saponins as antiviral agents against chikungunya virus and other arboviruses. The research highlights the growing global health burden of mosquito-borne viruses, including chikungunya, and the lack of specific therapies. A bioactivity-guided approach was used to screen extracts from eight Solanaceae species, identifying compounds that inhibit DENV-2 replication in Vero cells. Structural characterization and functional assays confirmed the antiviral activity of four spirostane-type steroidal saponins, with evidence suggesting their efficacy against multiple arboviruses. The findings indicate that these compounds could be promising scaffolds for developing broad-spectrum antiviral agents. However, the study is limited to in vitro results, which restricts the strength of the evidence to moderate. The results may inform future research into plant-derived therapies for chikungunya and related viruses, contributing to surveillance and treatment strategies.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在通过探索植物来源的新化合物,解决针对蚊媒虫媒病毒(包括基孔肯雅病毒)缺乏特异性抗病毒药物的问题。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究采用生物活性引导的方法来筛选来自八种茄科物种的甲醇提取物,以检测 Vero 细胞中针对 DENV-2 的 抗病毒药物 活性,重点是 基孔肯雅病毒。
elements_zh.methods: 研究人员使用生物活性引导的筛选、分馏和纯化技术来分离化合物,然后使用 UPLC-DAD-MS 和 1D/2D NMR 光谱进行结构表征,并进行功能测定以评估 抗病毒药物 活性。
elements_zh.main_results: 五种提取物显着降低了病毒感染性,其中包括 Solanum ovalifolium 和 Cestrum sp。在非细胞毒性浓度下实现完全抑制。分离出四种螺罗坦型甾体皂苷,并证明了 抗病毒药物 对抗 DENV-2 的活性。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究结果表明,螺罗坦皂苷可以作为有前途的 抗病毒药物 支架,为开发针对多种虫媒病毒的广谱 抗病毒药物 药物提供了潜力。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该结果为进一步研究植物源化合物作为 基孔肯雅病毒 和其他相关虫媒病毒的治疗选择奠定了基础,可能有助于 监测 和 治疗 策略。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于体外研究结果,不涉及体内疗效或临床转化,这将证据的强度降至中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 由蚊子传播的虫媒病毒,包括登革病毒(DENV)、寨卡病毒(ZIKV)和基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV),构成了日益增长的全球健康负担,但目前针对这些感染的特定抗病毒药物疗法尚不普及。这种未满足的需求凸显了从生物相关来源(如植物来源的天然产物)中识别新型抗病毒药物化合物的重要性。本研究采用生物活性引导的方法,对八种茄科植物的甲醇提取物进行筛选,以鉴定具有抗病毒药物活性的化合物,针对Vero细胞中的DENV-2。五种提取物显著降低了病毒感染性,其中Solanum ovalifolium和Cestrum sp.在非细胞毒性浓度下实现了完全抑制。随后的分级和纯化过程分离出四种螺甾烷型甾体皂苷,其结构通过UPLC-DAD-MS和1D/2D NMR光谱法进行了表征。功能实验表明,这些化合物抑制了DENV的复制,表现为病毒RNA水平的显著降低、NS1和NS3蛋白表达的减少以及传染性病毒滴度的下降。阶段特异性分析显示,其抗病毒药物活性主要与病毒生命周期的细胞内阶段相关,这与抑制病毒复制和/或蛋白加工一致。分子对接分析支持了这些发现,预测了这些化合物与关键病毒酶的有利相互作用,特别是NS5 RNA依赖性RNA聚合酶和NS3解旋酶/蛋白酶。重要的是,分离出的化合物对ZIKV和CHIKV也表现出抗病毒药物活性,表明其对多种虫媒病毒具有交叉疗效。综上所述,这些发现将螺甾烷皂苷识别为有前景的抗病毒药物骨架,并支持其进一步开发为广谱抗病毒药物药物。
