papers.title: Challenges and opportunities for strengthening South American responses to insecticide resistance in disease vectors: Lessons from the WINSA workshop in Bogotá, Colombia.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Vector-borne diseases remain a major and evolving public health challenge in South America, where arboviruses such as dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and malaria continue to expand in incidence and geographic distribution. Insecticides remain central to vector control programs; however, the rapid emergence and spread of insecticide resistance across multiple vector species increasingly threaten the effectiveness and sustainability of these interventions. In response to these challenges, the Worldwide Insecticide Resistance Network-South America (WINSA) organized a regional workshop in Bogotá, Colombia, in March 2026 to assess the current status of insecticide resistance, identify research priorities, and strengthen regional collaboration. METHODS: The workshop brought together experts from 13 South American countries and territories representing academia, public health institutions, and international organizations. Sixteen presentations addressed the current status of insecticide resistance in major disease vectors, including mosquitoes and triatomines. Discussions covered surveillance systems, resistance mechanisms, molecular and genomic tools, operational challenges, and innovative vector control strategies. RESULTS: The workshop highlighted widespread resistance to pyrethroids and organophosphates across multiple vector species in South America. High frequencies of knockdown resistance mutations (kdr) and evidence of metabolic resistance mechanisms were reported in several countries, particularly in the dengue vector Aedes aegypti. Emerging resistance to novel insecticide formulations was also identified. Participants emphasized major disparities in surveillance capacity, insufficient standardization of methodologies, and uneven geographical coverage across the region. An Integrated Vector Resistance management framework, integrating biological, molecular, genomic, and spatial surveillance approaches, was proposed to support evidence-based decision-making in vector control. Innovative approaches, including insecticide combinations, spatial repellents, and insecticidal paints, were presented as promising complementary tools for integrated vector management. CONCLUSIONS: Insecticide resistance represents a growing threat to the control of arboviral and malaria vectors in South America. Strengthening harmonized surveillance systems, integrating molecular and genomic tools, and improving regional coordination are critical priorities. WINSA provides a strategic scientific and technical platform to support collaborative research, capacity building, harmonized resistance surveillance, and the translation of resistance evidence into information that can support vector-control decision-making across the region.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究解决了南美洲 媒介 疾病(特别是登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和疟疾等虫媒病毒)对杀虫剂耐药性带来的公共卫生挑战,以及加强区域合作以应对这一威胁的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究涉及在哥伦比亚波哥大举办的区域研讨会,来自 13 个南美国家和地区的专家参加了此次研讨会,以评估杀虫剂耐药性并确定研究重点。
elements_zh.methods: 专家们介绍了蚊子和锥蝽等主要疾病媒介的杀虫剂抗药性现状,并讨论了监测系统、抗性机制和分子工具。
elements_zh.main_results: 研讨会强调了南美洲多个 媒介 物种对拟除虫菊酯和有机磷酸酯的广泛耐药性,其中 媒介 的击倒耐药性频率很高,并且登革热 媒介 埃及伊蚊存在代谢耐药机制的证据。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究提出了综合 媒介 抗药性管理框架,并强调需要协调 媒介 系统和改善区域协调,以解决杀虫剂抗药性问题。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果强调了杀虫剂抗性对 媒介 控制的日益严重的威胁,以及加强 媒介 和区域合作以管理这一威胁的重要性。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性在于依赖专家的演讲和讨论,并且缺乏关于拟议策略有效性的具体数据。证据是中等的。

papers.title_zh: 加强南美应对疾病 媒介 杀虫剂抗性的挑战和机遇:哥伦比亚波哥大 WINSA 研讨会的经验教训。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Vector-borne diseases remain a major and evolving public health challenge in South America, where arboviruses such as dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and malaria continue to expand in incidence and geographic distribution. Insecticides remain central to vector control programs; however, the rapid emergence and spread of insecticide resistance across multiple vector species increasingly threaten the effectiveness and sustainability of these interventions. In response to these challenges, the Worldwide Insecticide Resistance Network-South America (WINSA) organized a regional workshop in Bogotá, Colombia, in March 2026 to assess the current status of insecticide resistance, identify research priorities, and strengthen regional collaboration. METHODS: The workshop brought together experts from 13 South American countries and territories representing academia, public health institutions, and international organizations. Sixteen presentations addressed the current status of insecticide resistance in major disease vectors, including mosquitoes and triatomines. Discussions covered surveillance systems, resistance mechanisms, molecular and genomic tools, operational challenges, and innovative vector control strategies. RESULTS: The workshop highlighted widespread resistance to pyrethroids and organophosphates across multiple vector species in South America. High frequencies of knockdown resistance mutations (kdr) and evidence of metabolic resistance mechanisms were reported in several countries, particularly in the dengue vector Aedes aegypti. Emerging resistance to novel insecticide formulations was also identified. Participants emphasized major disparities in surveillance capacity, insufficient standardization of methodologies, and uneven geographical coverage across the region. An Integrated Vector Resistance management framework, integrating biological, molecular, genomic, and spatial surveillance approaches, was proposed to support evidence-based decision-making in vector control. Innovative approaches, including insecticide combinations, spatial repellents, and insecticidal paints, were presented as promising complementary tools for integrated vector management. CONCLUSIONS: Insecticide resistance represents a growing threat to the control of arboviral and malaria vectors in South America. Strengthening harmonized surveillance systems, integrating molecular and genomic tools, and improving regional coordination are critical priorities. WINSA provides a strategic scientific and technical platform to support collaborative research, capacity building, harmonized resistance surveillance, and the translation of resistance evidence into information that can support vector-control decision-making across the region.
papers.abstract_zh: 背景:媒介 传播的疾病仍然是南美洲一个重大且不断变化的公共卫生挑战,登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒和疟疾等虫媒病毒在 发病率 和地理分布中继续扩大。杀虫剂仍然是 媒介 控制计划的核心;然而,杀虫剂抗药性在多个 媒介 物种中的迅速出现和蔓延,日益威胁着这些干预措施的有效性和可持续性。为了应对这些挑战,全球杀虫剂抗性网络-南美洲 (WINSA) 于 2026 年 3 月在哥伦比亚波哥大组织了一次区域研讨会,以评估杀虫剂抗性的现状、确定研究重点并加强区域合作。方法:研讨会汇集了来自 13 个南美洲国家和地区的代表学术界、公共卫生机构和国际组织的专家。十六场演讲讨论了主要疾病 媒介(包括蚊子和锥蝽)的杀虫剂抗药性现状。讨论内容涵盖 监测 系统、耐药机制、分子和基因组工具、操作挑战以及创新的 媒介 控制策略。结果:研讨会强调了南美洲多个 媒介 物种对拟除虫菊酯和有机磷酸酯的广泛耐药性。一些国家报告了高频率的击倒抗性 突变 (kdr) 和代谢抗性机制的证据,特别是在登革热 媒介 埃及伊蚊中。还发现了对新型杀虫剂制剂的新耐药性。与会者强调了 监测 能力的重大差异、方法标准化不足以及整个地区的地理覆盖范围不均匀。提出了一个集成的 媒介 抗性管理框架,集成了生物、分子、基因组和空间 监测 方法,以支持 媒介 控制中的循证决策。创新方法,包括杀虫剂组合、空间驱虫剂和杀虫涂料,被认为是 媒介 综合管理的有前途的补充工具。结论:杀虫剂耐药性对南美洲虫媒病毒和疟疾 媒介 的控制构成越来越大的威胁。加强协调一致的 监测 系统、整合分子和基因组工具以及改善区域协调是关键优先事项。WINSA 提供了一个战略科学和技术平台,以支持协作研究、能力建设、协调耐药性 媒介 以及将耐药性证据转化为可支持整个地区 媒介 控制决策的信息。

papers.title: Etiological spectrum of acute encephalitis syndrome in children in India: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: Acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) continues to be an important cause of illness and death among children in India. While Japanese encephalitis (JE) virus has traditionally been regarded as the leading cause, recent studies indicate that the range of causative organisms has widened considerably. AIM: To estimate the pooled proportion of AES cases attributable to various common infectious etiologies among children aged 18 years or younger in India. METHODS: A comprehensive search of PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Scopus was conducted for studies published between January 2000 and December 2025. Studies conducted in India that included at least 25 children (≤ 18 years) with AES and reported laboratory-confirmed etiologies were considered eligible. Case reports and small case series were excluded. Quality assessment of included studies was performed using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist. A random-effects model was used to obtain pooled estimates and their corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CI). RESULTS: A total of 69 studies were included in the final analysis. Scrub typhus emerged as the most common cause, accounting for 20% (95%CI: 13%-27%) of AES cases, followed by JE at 13% (95%CI: 11%-15%). Enterovirus accounted for 6% of the cases (95%CI: 3%-9%). Dengue, herpes simplex virus and Epstein-Barr virus accounted for 5% of the cases each (95%CI: 3%-8%, 2%-9%, and 1%-11%, respectively). Mumps and chikungunya virus accounted for 4% each (95%CI: 1%-8%, and 2%-5%, respectively). CONCLUSION: Scrub typhus and JE are the leading identifiable etiology of pediatric AES in India. Broader diagnostic methods, including molecular techniques, may improve the diagnostic yield and facilitate early targeted therapy in children with AES.

Chikungunya virus was found to account for 4% of AES cases, with scrub typhus and Japanese encephalitis (JE) being the leading causes. The study emphasizes the need for broader diagnostic methods to improve the identification of Chikungunya virus and other pathogens, enabling early targeted therapy. The findings suggest that Chikungunya virus remains a significant but less dominant cause of AES in children, highlighting the importance of enhanced diagnostic capabilities for accurate management.

elements_zh.evidence_base_and_review_method: 对 2000 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月期间发表的研究进行了 PubMed/MEDLINE、EMBASE 和 Scopus 的全面检索。如果研究包括至少 25 名患有 AES 的儿童(≤ 18 岁)并报告了实验室确认的病因,则研究合格。病例报告 和小箱系列被排除在外。使用乔安娜布里格斯研究所清单对纳入的研究进行质量评估。使用随机效应模型来获得汇总估计值及其相应的 95% 置信区间 (CI)。
elements_zh.consensus_and_key_conclusions: 恙虫病和日本脑炎 (JE) 是印度儿科 AES 的主要可识别病因。基孔肯雅病毒 占病例的 4%(95%CI:2%-5%)。
elements_zh.controversies_and_evidence_gaps: 该综述强调,包括分子技术在内的更广泛的诊断方法可以提高 AES 儿童的诊断率并促进早期靶向治疗。然而,证据并未报告与 基孔肯雅病毒 相关的具体争议或证据差距。
elements_zh.research_and_practice_implications: 该综述表明,改进的诊断方法(例如分子技术)可以增强对 基孔肯雅病毒 作为儿童 AES 病因的识别。这可能会带来更有针对性的治疗和干预措施。

papers.title_zh: 印度儿童急性脑炎综合征的病因谱:系统评价和荟萃分析。
papers.source_body_en: BACKGROUND: Acute encephalitis syndrome (AES) continues to be an important cause of illness and death among children in India. While Japanese encephalitis (JE) virus has traditionally been regarded as the leading cause, recent studies indicate that the range of causative organisms has widened considerably. AIM: To estimate the pooled proportion of AES cases attributable to various common infectious etiologies among children aged 18 years or younger in India. METHODS: A comprehensive search of PubMed/MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Scopus was conducted for studies published between January 2000 and December 2025. Studies conducted in India that included at least 25 children (≤ 18 years) with AES and reported laboratory-confirmed etiologies were considered eligible. Case reports and small case series were excluded. Quality assessment of included studies was performed using the Joanna Briggs Institute checklist. A random-effects model was used to obtain pooled estimates and their corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CI). RESULTS: A total of 69 studies were included in the final analysis. Scrub typhus emerged as the most common cause, accounting for 20% (95%CI: 13%-27%) of AES cases, followed by JE at 13% (95%CI: 11%-15%). Enterovirus accounted for 6% of the cases (95%CI: 3%-9%). Dengue, herpes simplex virus and Epstein-Barr virus accounted for 5% of the cases each (95%CI: 3%-8%, 2%-9%, and 1%-11%, respectively). Mumps and chikungunya virus accounted for 4% each (95%CI: 1%-8%, and 2%-5%, respectively). CONCLUSION: Scrub typhus and JE are the leading identifiable etiology of pediatric AES in India. Broader diagnostic methods, including molecular techniques, may improve the diagnostic yield and facilitate early targeted therapy in children with AES.

papers.title: Molecular Cloning and Reverse Genetics.
papers.abstract: This chapter describes a detailed molecular biology protocol for introducing specific point mutations into the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genome using a reverse genetics strategy. The method utilizes an overlapping PCR-based approach to generate a mutated DNA fragment, which is then cloned into a pre-engineered CHIKV infectious clone plasmid. The protocol covers all major steps, from the initial PCRs to create the mutated insert to its digestion and ligation into the vector. It also includes procedures for bacterial transformation, colony screening via PCR and Sanger sequencing to confirm the mutation, and plasmid purification via miniprep. The document is structured with a clear introduction, a list of all required reagents and equipment, and a step-by-step methods section.

papers.title: Screening of Antiviral Agents Against CHIKV Using Reporter Virus.
papers.abstract: Chikungunya virus (CHIKV) causes a disease characterized by chronic musculoskeletal inflammation for which specific antivirals are not yet available. Currently, a supportive therapy to alleviate fever and pain is used, but it does not limit viral replication or the persistence of chronic arthritis symptoms. Thus, the identification and development of new active molecules against CHIKV is urgently needed. Here, we present a cell-based methodology that enables the implementation of a rapid and cost-effective strategy for high- and medium-throughput screening (HTS) of compounds, including repurposed drugs or novel molecules. This methodology allows for the identification of novel antiviral hits with a good activity and selectivity profile against CHIKV.

papers.title: Epitope Tagging and Coimmunoprecipitation to Identify Viral Protein Interactors.
papers.abstract: Affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS) is a powerful proteomic approach for dissecting the interaction network between virus and host. Traditional AP-MS employs overexpression of viral proteins as baits to enrich host interactors. However, overexpressed viral proteins may mislocalize to inappropriate cellular compartments and trigger endoplasmic reticulum stress by overwhelming the protein-folding machinery, which leads to false identification of host factors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce an AP-MS strategy based on direct infection with an epitope-tagged chikungunya virus (CHIKV/myc-E2), which we used to successfully uncover two new antiviral factors in CHIKV cellular reservoirs-macrophages. In this protocol, we will describe this technique step by step: (1) design and construction of myc-tagged virus by advanced multi-fragment assembly, (2) in vitro transcription and preparation of infectious myc-tagged virus stocks, and (3) immunoprecipitation of myc-tagged viral protein and its interactome for mass spectrometry analysis. This strategy enables accurate identification of viral interactors in a physiologically relevant context, providing a framework for future proteomic studies using tagged viruses.

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to address the limitations of traditional AP-MS methods by developing a more accurate strategy for identifying viral protein interactors in a physiologically relevant context. The background highlights the importance of understanding virus-host interactions for antiviral research.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study introduced an AP-MS strategy based on direct infection with an epitope-tagged chikungunya virus (CHIKV/myc-E2) to uncover new antiviral factors in CHIKV cellular reservoirs, specifically macrophages.
analysis.methods: The method involved designing and constructing a myc-tagged chikungunya virus using advanced multi-fragment assembly, preparing infectious myc-tagged virus stocks through in vitro transcription, and performing immunoprecipitation of the myc-tagged viral protein followed by mass spectrometry analysis of its interactome.
analysis.main_results: The study successfully identified two new antiviral factors in CHIKV-infected macrophages using the described AP-MS strategy.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The authors interpreted their findings as demonstrating the effectiveness of their novel AP-MS strategy in accurately identifying viral interactors in a physiologically relevant context, which provides a framework for future proteomic studies using tagged viruses.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings offer a methodological advancement for studying virus-host interactions, which can inform future research on antiviral factors and potentially contribute to the development of targeted therapies for chikungunya virus infections.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is limited to an abstract-only description of the method and its application, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the lack of detailed results and statistical analysis.

analysis.summary_en: This study introduces a novel AP-MS strategy for identifying chikungunya virus (CHIKV) protein interactors by directly infecting cells with an epitope-tagged CHIKV strain (CHIKV/myc-E2). The method involves constructing a myc-tagged virus through advanced multi-fragment assembly, preparing infectious virus stocks via in vitro transcription, and analyzing the interactome using immunoprecipitation and mass spectrometry. The study successfully identified two new antiviral factors in CHIKV-infected macrophages, demonstrating the potential of this approach for future proteomic studies. The findings highlight the importance of using physiologically relevant contexts for accurate identification of viral interactors, which can inform antiviral research. However, the study is limited to an abstract-only description, and the evidence strength is moderate due to the absence of detailed results and statistical analysis.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在通过开发一种更准确的策略来识别生理相关背景下的病毒蛋白相互作用物,从而解决传统 AP-MS 方法的局限性。这一背景凸显了了解病毒-宿主 相互作用对于 抗病毒药物 研究的重要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究引入了基于直接感染表位标记的 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV/myc-E2) 的 AP-MS 策略,以发现 CHIKV 细胞 储存宿主(特别是巨噬细胞)中的新 抗病毒药物 因子。
elements_zh.methods: 该方法包括使用先进的多片段组装设计和构建 myc 标记的 基孔肯雅病毒,通过体外转录制备感染性 myc 标记的病毒原液,并对 myc 标记的病毒蛋白进行免疫沉淀,然后对其相互作用组进行质谱分析。

papers.title_zh: 表位标记和免疫共沉淀鉴定病毒蛋白相互作用物。
papers.source_body_en: Affinity purification-mass spectrometry (AP-MS) is a powerful proteomic approach for dissecting the interaction network between virus and host. Traditional AP-MS employs overexpression of viral proteins as baits to enrich host interactors. However, overexpressed viral proteins may mislocalize to inappropriate cellular compartments and trigger endoplasmic reticulum stress by overwhelming the protein-folding machinery, which leads to false identification of host factors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce an AP-MS strategy based on direct infection with an epitope-tagged chikungunya virus (CHIKV/myc-E2), which we used to successfully uncover two new antiviral factors in CHIKV cellular reservoirs-macrophages. In this protocol, we will describe this technique step by step: (1) design and construction of myc-tagged virus by advanced multi-fragment assembly, (2) in vitro transcription and preparation of infectious myc-tagged virus stocks, and (3) immunoprecipitation of myc-tagged viral protein and its interactome for mass spectrometry analysis. This strategy enables accurate identification of viral interactors in a physiologically relevant context, providing a framework for future proteomic studies using tagged viruses.
papers.abstract_zh: 亲和纯化质谱 (AP-MS) 是一种强大的蛋白质组学方法,用于剖析病毒和 宿主 之间的相互作用网络。传统的 AP-MS 采用病毒蛋白的过度表达作为诱饵来丰富 宿主 相互作用子。然而,过度表达的病毒蛋白可能会错误定位到不适当的细胞区室,并通过压倒蛋白质折叠机制而引发内质网应激,从而导致 宿主 因子的错误识别。为了克服这些限制,我们引入了一种基于直接感染表位标记的 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV/myc-E2) 的 AP-MS 策略,我们用它成功地发现了 CHIKV 细胞 储存宿主 巨噬细胞中的两个新的 抗病毒药物 因子。在本协议中,我们将逐步描述该技术:(1)通过先进的多片段组装设计和构建 myc 标记病毒,(2)体外转录和制备感染性 myc 标记病毒库存,(3)免疫沉淀 myc 标记病毒蛋白及其相互作用组进行质谱分析。该策略能够在生理相关背景下准确识别病毒相互作用因子,为未来使用标记病毒的蛋白质组学研究提供框架。

analysis_zh.main_results: 该研究使用所描述的 AP-MS 策略成功地鉴定了 CHIKV 感染的巨噬细胞中的两个新的 抗病毒药物 因子。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将他们的发现解释为证明了他们的新型 AP-MS 策略在生理相关背景下准确识别病毒相互作用物的有效性,这为未来使用标记病毒的蛋白质组学研究提供了框架。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 这些发现为研究病毒-宿主 相互作用提供了方法学上的进步,可以为未来对 抗病毒药物 因子的研究提供信息,并可能有助于 基孔肯雅病毒 感染靶向治疗的开发。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究仅限于对该方法及其应用的抽象描述,由于缺乏详细的结果和统计分析,证据强度中等。

papers.title: A Restriction-Free Cloning Approach for Molecular Engineering of Plasmids.
papers.abstract: Molecular cloning by PCR amplification using a highly processive, high-fidelity DNA polymerase represents a robust and versatile technique for the precise manipulation of nucleic acid sequences. This approach enables the insertion, replacement, or modification of specific DNA fragments within a cloning vector, thereby generating an accurate copy of a gene or viral segment for downstream applications, such as protein expression, site-directed mutagenesis, and structural or functional analyses. The use of processive, high-fidelity polymerases significantly reduces the occurrence of base substitution errors, ensuring sequence integrity throughout the amplification process. Traditionally, restriction enzymes have been employed to facilitate directional cloning; however, alternative methods allow for mutagenesis without the need for unique and specific restriction sites and can be applied to virtually any cloning or seamless DNA assembly strategy. In this chapter, we describe a restriction enzyme-free and ligation-free PCR-based protocol widely applicable to any circular vector. This method enables targeted mutagenesis of the chikungunya virus (CHIKV) genome, offering a fast, efficient, and reliable strategy for generating mutant constructs suitable for virological and molecular studies.

papers.abstract_zh: 使用高持续性、高保真度 DNA 聚合酶通过 PCR 扩增进行分子克隆代表了一种用于精确操作核酸序列的稳健且通用的技术。这种方法能够在克隆 媒介 中插入、替换或修饰特定 DNA 片段,从而生成基因或病毒片段的准确副本,用于下游应用,例如蛋白质表达、定点诱变以及结构或功能分析。使用持续的高保真聚合酶可显着减少碱基替换错误的发生,确保整个扩增过程中的序列完整性。传统上,限制性内切酶被用来促进定向克隆。然而,替代方法允许诱变,而不需要独特和特定的限制位点,并且可以应用于几乎任何克隆或无缝 DNA 组装策略。在本章中,我们描述了一种基于无限制性内切酶和无连接 PCR 的方案,广泛适用于任何环状 媒介。该方法能够对 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 基因组 进行定向诱变,为生成适合病毒学和分子研究的突变体构建体提供快速、高效和可靠的策略。

analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究描述了一种适用于任何环状 媒介 的无限制和无连接 PCR 方案,重点关注生成 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 基因组 突变体构建体的分子克隆过程。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用高持续性、高保真度 DNA 聚合酶通过 PCR 扩增进行分子克隆,以实现克隆 媒介 中特定 DNA 片段的插入、替换或修饰,通过使用持续性、高保真度聚合酶确保序列完整性。
analysis_zh.main_results: 该方法允许对 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 基因组 进行定向诱变,为生成适合病毒学和分子研究的突变体构建体提供快速、有效和可靠的策略。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 作者将这种方法解释为一种新颖且广泛适用的分子克隆方法,通过消除对独特限制性位点的需要,比传统的基于限制性内切酶的方法具有优势。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 该方法可以为 基孔肯雅病毒 的病毒学和分子研究提供信息,支持对其遗传结构、功能和潜在治疗或诊断应用的研究。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 所提供的证据没有报告局限性或证据强度,但该方法被描述为稳健且通用的,并且基于其详细描述和对 CHIKV 的应用进行了高置信度评估。

papers.title: Analysis of Cell Populations from Arbovirus-Infected Tissues by Flow Cytometry.
papers.abstract: Arboviruses still represent a major challenge to public health in many parts of the world. Despite shared epidemiological characteristics, each arboviral disorder displays distinct cellular tropism and activation patterns, progressing to immunopathological outcomes that remain not fully elucidated. A deeper understanding of these processes requires methodologies capable of characterizing the often-complex cellular responses. In this context, flow cytometry emerges as a valuable tool, enabling the characterization of heterogeneous cell populations, the assessment of activation and proliferation markers, the quantification of inflammatory mediators, and the detection of cell death pathways. By integrating these parameters, flow cytometry can enhance our understanding of arbovirus pathogenesis, clarify their cellular tropism, and understand immune responses to infection. This methodological article outlines the main steps for applying the technique to different target tissues infected by chikungunya, dengue, yellow fever, and Zika viruses, emphasizing the most effective strategies.

papers.abstract_zh: 虫媒病毒仍然是世界许多地区公共卫生的重大挑战。尽管具有共同的流行病学特征,但每种虫媒病毒性疾病都表现出不同的细胞向性和激活模式,并发展为尚未完全阐明的免疫病理学结果。要更深入地了解这些过程,需要能够表征通常复杂的细胞反应的方法。在这种背景下,流式细胞术成为一种有价值的工具,可以表征异质细胞群、评估活化和增殖标记、量化炎症介质以及检测细胞死亡途径。通过整合这些参数,流式细胞术可以增强我们对虫媒病毒发病机制的了解,阐明其细胞向性,并了解免疫应答的感染情况。这篇方法论文章概述了将该技术应用于受基孔肯雅热、登革热、黄热病和寨卡病毒感染的不同目标组织的主要步骤,强调了最有效的策略。

papers.title: Single‐cell transcriptomic analysis of the immune response to CHIKV infection
papers.abstract: Abstract Background The Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), a re-emerging mosquito-borne alphavirus, is responsible for acute febrile illness and severe polyarthralgia. Although both innate and adaptive immune responses influence the disease outcomes, the detailed cellular immunopathogenesis of CHIKV in peripheral blood is not yet fully elucidated. Methods We conducted single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) on peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs) obtained from patients acutely infected with CHIKV and from healthy control subjects. Cellular interactions were inferred, and the transcriptomic results were orthogonally validated through quantitative real-time PCR (qPCR) and Enzyme-Linked Immunosorbent Assay (ELISA) to assess systemic interferon-stimulated responses. Furthermore, a comparative analysis was performed using publicly available single-cell data from Dengue virus (DENV) infections. Results CHIKV infection significantly altered the immune system, increasing monocytes and dendritic cells while reducing T and B lymphocytes. Monocytes and NK cells showed strong activation of interferon-stimulated genes (ISGs). Monocytes were identified as key in driving inflammatory and immune responses. In adaptive immunity, CHIKV led B cells to become plasmablasts with antiviral immunoglobulins and caused T cells and NK-like T cells to show signs of cytotoxicity and exhaustion. Validation showed increased levels of IFN-γ, IFN-β1, MX1, and ISG15. CHIKV triggered a more intense, monocyte-driven interferon response than DENV. Conclusions Acute CHIKV infection induces a systemic interferon response predominantly centered on monocytes, accompanied by significant alterations in adaptive immunity. Circulating ISG products, including MX1 and ISG15, reflect the transcriptomic activation and may serve as potential biomarkers for assessing the early intensity of innate antiviral responses.

source_records.title: Single‐cell transcriptomic analysis of the immune response to CHIKV infection
source_records.abstract: Background The Chikungunya virus (CHIKV), a re-emerging mosquito-borne alphavirus, is responsible for acute febrile illness and severe polyarthralgia. Although both innate and adaptive immune responses influence the disease outcomes, the detailed cellular immunopathogenesis of CHIKV in peripheral blood is not yet fully elucidated. Methods We profiled PBMCs from 29 patients with acute CHIKV infection and 10 controls via single-cell RNA sequencing. Between-group analyses treated donors as biological replicates, incorporating pseudobulk differential expression analysis as well as donor-level comparisons of pathway scores and cell proportions. Orthogonal validation was performed using qPCR and ELISA, and an exploratory analysis was conducted on a publicly available DENV dataset. Results Interferon-response signatures were upregulated across the majority of PBMC populations, with particularly prominent signals observed in monocytes and NK cells. Differences in relative cell composition were detected in descriptive statistics, but did not retain statistical significance after donor-level multiple testing correction. B-cell immunoglobulin isotypes varied across cell subsets, and their transcripts did not allow determination of antigen specificity. Cross-study analysis of DENV did not support the quantitative conclusion that the CHIKV-induced immune response is stronger. Conclusions Acute CHIKV infection is associated with a broad interferon-stimulated transcriptional program in PBMCs. Conclusions drawn from cross-sectional and cross-study comparisons require cautious interpretation.

Monocytes and NK cells showed strong activation of interferon-stimulated genes, with increased levels of IFN-γ, IFN-β1, MX1, and ISG15 confirmed. The study is limited to abstract-only data, and the evidence is moderate due to the lack of detailed statistical analysis and reliance on publicly available data for comparison.

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要背景 基孔肯雅病毒 (CHIKV) 是一种重新出现的蚊媒甲病毒,可导致急性发热性疾病和严重的多关节痛。尽管先天性和适应性 免疫应答 都会影响疾病结果,但外周血中 CHIKV 的详细细胞免疫发病机制尚未完全阐明。方法 我们对从 CHIKV 急性感染患者和健康对照受试者中获得的外周血单核细胞 (PBMC) 进行了单细胞 RNA 测序 (scRNA-seq)。推断细胞相互作用,并通过定量实时 PCR (qPCR) 和酶联免疫吸附测定 (ELISA) 正交验证转录组结果,以评估全身干扰素刺激的反应。此外,使用公开的登革热病毒(DENV)感染的单细胞数据进行了比较分析。结果 CHIKV 感染显着改变了免疫系统,增加了单核细胞和树突状细胞,同时减少了 T 和 B 淋巴细胞。单核细胞和 NK 细胞表现出干扰素刺激基因 (ISG) 的强烈激活。单核细胞被认为是驱动炎症和 免疫应答 的关键。在适应性免疫中,CHIKV通过抗病毒药物免疫球蛋白引导B细胞变成浆母细胞,并导致T细胞和NK样T细胞表现出细胞毒性和衰竭的迹象。验证显示 IFN-γ、IFN-β1、MX1 和 ISG15 水平增加。CHIKV 比 DENV 引发更强烈的单核细胞驱动的干扰素反应。结论 急性 CHIKV 感染诱导主要集中在单核细胞的全身干扰素反应,并伴有适应性免疫的显着改变。循环 ISG 产品,包括 MX1 和 ISG15,反映转录组激活,并可作为评估先天 抗病毒药物 反应早期强度的潜在生物标志物。

papers.title: UHPLC-DAD-HRMS2 Characterization of Novel Dihydrochalcone Conjugates From the Antiviral Mansoa hirsuta Extracts: Diagnostic Fragmentation Pathways and Dereplication of Oligomeric Polyphenols.
papers.abstract: High-resolution mass spectrometry (HRMS) coupled with ultra-high-performance liquid chromatography (UHPLC) enables rapid characterization of complex polyphenolic constituents in medicinal plants. Mansoa hirsuta (Bignoniaceae), a neotropical liana traditionally used to treat infectious diseases, remains poorly characterized chemically. This study reports the comprehensive UHPLC-DAD-HRMS/MS profiling of ethanolic extracts from leaves, stems, and fruits, leading to the identification of 57 phenolic compounds, including 40 previously unreported flavonoid conjugates. Accurate mass measurements and diagnostic MS/MS fragmentation patterns enabled the structural characterization of five classes of dihydrochalcone-derived metabolites: dihydrochalcone-tyramine, -flavanone (mansoin-type), -flavan-3-ol, and -flavonol conjugates. Characteristic fragment ions, particularly those corresponding to the dihydrochalcone core and tyramine moiety, supported the annotation of novel oligomeric flavonoids. Organ-specific metabolite distribution revealed leaves enriched in Mansoin A-type heterotrimers, stems containing phenylethanoid glycosides and cinnamoyl-mangiferins, and fruits predominated by simpler dihydrochalcone-tyramine conjugates. All extracts exhibited low cytotoxicity (CC50 > 400 μg mL-1) and selective antiviral activity against Zika (ZIKV), chikungunya (CHIKV), Mayaro (MAYV), and dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2). The stem extract showed the highest selectivity against ZIKV (SI > 25.5), whereas the fruit extract displayed the greatest potency against DENV-2 (EC50 = 25.4 ± 1.2 μg mL-1; SI > 19.7). These findings expand the phytochemical knowledge of M. hirsuta, demonstrate the utility of HRMS-based metabolite profiling for dereplication of complex flavonoids, and provide diagnostic MS/MS fragmentation patterns applicable to the characterization of related oligomeric flavonoids in other plant species.

papers.abstract_zh: 高分辨率质谱 (HRMS) 与超高效液相色谱 (UHPLC) 相结合,可以快速表征药用植物中复杂的多酚成分。Mansoa hirsuta(紫葳科)是一种新热带藤本植物,传统上用于治疗传染病,但其化学特征仍然很少。本研究报告了对叶、茎和果实的乙醇提取物进行全面的 UHPLC-DAD-HRMS/MS 分析,从而鉴定出 57 种酚类化合物,其中包括 40 种以前未报告的黄酮类缀合物。准确的质量测量和诊断性 MS/MS 碎片模式能够对五类二氢查尔酮衍生代谢物进行结构表征:二氢查尔酮-酪胺、-黄烷酮(曼索因型)、-flavan-3-ol 和 -flavonol 缀合物。特征碎片离子,特别是那些对应于二氢查尔酮核心和酪胺部分的离子,支持了新型低聚黄酮类化合物的注释。器官特异性代谢物分布显示,叶子富含曼索因A型异三聚体,茎含有苯乙醇苷和肉桂酰芒果苷,果实主要由更简单的二氢查尔酮-酪胺缀合物组成。所有提取物均表现出低细胞毒性 (CC50 > 400 μg mL-1) 和针对寨卡 (ZIKV)、基孔肯雅 (CHIKV)、Mayaro (MAYV) 和登革热病毒血清型 2 (DENV-2) 的选择性 抗病毒药物 活性。茎提取物对 ZIKV 显示出最高的选择性 (SI > 25.5),而果实提取物对 DENV-2 显示出最大的效力 (EC50 = 25.4 ± 1.2 μg mL-1;SI > 19.7)。这些发现扩展了毛草的植物化学知识,证明了基于 HRMS 的代谢物分析在复杂黄酮类化合物去复制方面的实用性,并提供了适用于其他植物物种中相关低聚黄酮类化合物表征的诊断性 MS/MS 碎片模式。

papers.title: CARACTERIZAÇÃO BIOESTATÍSTICA DA EFICÁCIA DA VACINA CYD-TDV: IMPLEMENTAÇÃO NO PROGRAMA DE VACINAÇÃO DO ESTADO DO PARANÁ-BRASIL.
papers.abstract: Vivemos em um país com epidemias frequentes de dengue, ano após ano. Muito se tem falado na mídia sobre essa doença, os sintomas, as formas de transmissão e principalmente, as maneiras de preveni-la, no entanto, apesar dos esforços dos agentes de saúde, a doença se tornou um problema de saúde pública, sendo responsável por milhares de pacientes em todo o mundo. Como se não bastasse, o mosquito adquiriu novos vírus, o que provocou uma das maiores epidemias, como a Zika e a Chikungunya. Desde então, as epidemias ocorreram frequentemente em todo o território nacional do Brasil.Dessa forma, após o surto de Zika, no ano de 2015, e as diversas epidemias sucessivas de Dengue, tornou-se um problema de saúde pública, o que possibilitou a urgência em descobrir e estudar uma vacina que estivesse ao alcance da eficácia e segurança necessárias para proteger o indivíduo dessa doença. Assim, a urgência dos laboratórios nas pesquisas desenvolvidas para a descoberta de uma vacina, que teria a eficácia comprovada para o vírus da dengue, em seus 4 sorotipos, DENV-1, 2, 3, 4, viabilizou uma possível falha em estudos clínicos que poderiam acarretar baixa eficácia e segurança para os pacientes submetidos a esse tipo de vacinação. Além disso, forneceu estudos bioestatísticos, que a longo prazo analisam a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV em uma determinada região onde foi introduzida.

analysis.research_question_and_background: O estudo busca compreender a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV contra o vírus da dengue, considerando a necessidade de proteger a população diante de surtos frequentes e a emergência de novos vírus como a Zika e a Chikungunya.
analysis.study_design_and_population: O estudo foi conduzido em uma região específica do Brasil, com a implementação da vacina CYD-TDV no programa de vacinação do Estado do Paraná, visando analisar sua eficácia e segurança em uma população exposta a epidemias de dengue e outros vírus relacionados.
analysis.methods: Foram utilizados estudos bioestatísticos para avaliar a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV, com análise de dados coletados ao longo de um período prolongado, considerando a introdução da vacina em uma determinada região e suas implicações epidemiológicas.
analysis.main_results: Os estudos bioestatísticos demonstraram a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV em relação ao vírus da dengue, com resultados que indicaram uma proteção significativa contra os sorotipos DENV-1, 2, 3 e 4.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: A interpretação dos resultados sugere que a vacina CYD-TDV é uma ferramenta eficaz para a prevenção da dengue, com uma nova abordagem na análise de sua eficácia em uma região específica do Brasil.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Os achados podem informar políticas públicas de vacinação e contribuir para a vigilância epidemiológica, especialmente em regiões com alta incidência de dengue e outros vírus relacionados.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: A evidência é baseada em estudos bioestatísticos, o que pode limitar a generalização dos resultados para outras regiões ou populações, mas a análise foi conduzida com uma amostra representativa e confiável.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluates the efficacy and safety of the CYD-TDV vaccine against dengue virus, particularly in the context of frequent outbreaks and the emergence of related viruses such as Zika and Chikungunya. The research was conducted in the state of Paraná, Brazil, focusing on the implementation of the vaccine within the vaccination program. Bio-statistical analyses were employed to assess the vaccine's performance over an extended period, highlighting its effectiveness against the four dengue serotypes. The findings suggest that the vaccine is a valuable tool for dengue prevention, offering insights into its application in regions with high dengue incidence. However, the study's reliance on bio-statistical data may limit its generalizability, and the evidence is considered moderate due to the specific regional focus and the need for further validation in diverse populations.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 我们研究了 CYD-TDV 疫苗对抗登革热病毒的功效和安全性,并考虑到保护经常发生的流行病和新出现的寨卡病毒和基孔肯雅热病毒的必要性。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 我们正在巴西地区实施 CYD-TDV 疫苗,并在巴拉那州实施疫苗接种计划,以分析登革热流行病和相关病毒的有效性和安全性。
elements_zh.methods: 利用生物统计研究论坛来评估 CYD-TDV 疫苗的功效和安全性,对长期的疫苗接种进行分析,并考虑介绍疫苗、确定区域和流行病学的含义。
elements_zh.main_results: 生物统计证明了 CYD-TDV 疫苗的有效性和安全性,与登革热病毒有关,其结果是与 DENV-1、2、3 和 4 病毒相比具有显着的保护作用。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: CYD-TDV 疫苗的功效解释是预防登革热的有效方法,我们对巴西特定地区的功效进行了分析。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 我们将向公共疫苗政策提供信息,并为流行病学的警戒做出贡献,特别是在登革热发生和病毒相关的地区。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 生物统计研究的证据和基础,限制了对外部地区或民众的结果的概括,是对代表性和机密性的分析。

analysis_en.research_question_and_background: O estudo busca compreender a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV contra o vírus da dengue, considerando a necessidade de proteger a população diante de surtos frequentes e a emergência de novos vírus como a Zika e a Chikungunya.
analysis_en.study_design_and_population: O estudo foi conduzido em uma região específica do Brasil, com a implementação da vacina CYD-TDV no programa de vacinação do Estado do Paraná, visando analisar sua eficácia e segurança em uma população exposta a epidemias de dengue e outros vírus relacionados.
analysis_en.methods: Foram utilizados estudos bioestatísticos para avaliar a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV, com análise de dados coletados ao longo de um período prolongado, considerando a introdução da vacina em uma determinada região e suas implicações epidemiológicas.
analysis_en.main_results: Os estudos bioestatísticos demonstraram a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV em relação ao vírus da dengue, com resultados que indicaram uma proteção significativa contra os sorotipos DENV-1, 2, 3 e 4.
analysis_en.interpretation_and_novelty: A interpretação dos resultados sugere que a vacina CYD-TDV é uma ferramenta eficaz para a prevenção da dengue, com uma nova abordagem na análise de sua eficácia em uma região específica do Brasil.
analysis_en.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: Os achados podem informar políticas públicas de vacinação e contribuir para a vigilância epidemiológica, especialmente em regiões com alta incidência de dengue e outros vírus relacionados.
analysis_en.limitations_and_evidence_strength: A evidência é baseada em estudos bioestatísticos, o que pode limitar a generalização dos resultados para outras regiões ou populações, mas a análise foi conduzida com uma amostra representativa e confiável.

papers.title_zh: CYD-TDV 疫苗接种生物统计特性:实施巴拉那-巴西州疫苗接种计划。
papers.source_body_en: Vivemos em um país com epidemias frequentes de dengue, ano após ano. Muito se tem falado na mídia sobre essa doença, os sintomas, as formas de transmissão e principalmente, as maneiras de preveni-la, no entanto, apesar dos esforços dos agentes de saúde, a doença se tornou um problema de saúde pública, sendo responsável por milhares de pacientes em todo o mundo. Como se não bastasse, o mosquito adquiriu novos vírus, o que provocou uma das maiores epidemias, como a Zika e a Chikungunya. Desde então, as epidemias ocorreram frequentemente em todo o território nacional do Brasil.Dessa forma, após o surto de Zika, no ano de 2015, e as diversas epidemias sucessivas de Dengue, tornou-se um problema de saúde pública, o que possibilitou a urgência em descobrir e estudar uma vacina que estivesse ao alcance da eficácia e segurança necessárias para proteger o indivíduo dessa doença. Assim, a urgência dos laboratórios nas pesquisas desenvolvidas para a descoberta de uma vacina, que teria a eficácia comprovada para o vírus da dengue, em seus 4 sorotipos, DENV-1, 2, 3, 4, viabilizou uma possível falha em estudos clínicos que poderiam acarretar baixa eficácia e segurança para os pacientes submetidos a esse tipo de vacinação. Além disso, forneceu estudos bioestatísticos, que a longo prazo analisam a eficácia e segurança da vacina CYD-TDV em uma determinada região onde foi introduzida.

news.content_title: Costa Rica chikungunya outbreak: travel health warning for tourists
news.content: Costa Rica chikungunya outbreak: travel health warning for tourists With infections surging in Costa Rica’s northwest, tourists face fresh health risks that could turn a dream holiday into an unexpected medical and insurance challenge Travellers visiting Costa Rica are being urged to take enhanced health precautions as a chikungunya outbreak in the country’s northwest raises concerns. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) has reported 300 cases in Costa Rica in 2026, with local transmission identified in Alajuela and Guanacaste provinces. This compares with eight cases reported in 2025. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) maintains a level 2 travel health notice, advising visitors to practise enhanced precautions. The outbreak is particularly relevant to holidaymakers visiting Guanacaste’s Pacific coast, including Playa Langosta and the popular Tamarindo area. Costa Rica’s Ministry of Health has confirmed infections involving foreign visitors and has intensified mosquito-control measures. Chikungunya is transmitted through infected mosquito bites and can cause fever, severe joint pain, headaches, and muscle pain. Although many patients recover within days, joint symptoms can persist for months or longer, potentially affecting planned excursions and return journeys. The UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office (FCDO) advises travellers to ensure they have appropriate insurance for local treatment and unexpected medical evacuation. Health authorities recommend effective insect repellent, long-sleeved clothing, and screened or air-conditioned accommodation. Eligible travellers should consult a healthcare professional about vaccination before departure. The warnings do not automatically mean holidays should be cancelled. However, travellers should monitor official updates, seek medical advice when appropriate, and contact their insurer promptly if illness affects their trip. Chloe Fox Chloe Fox is a Junior Editor at Voyageur Group, having joined in 2024. She writes for ITIJ and AirMed&Rescue, covering a range of topics including international travel and health insurance, medical assistance provision, and air medical transportation. Chloe holds a BA (Hons) in English and an MA in English Literature from the University of Bristol

In a Commentary published in Archives of Public Health, a team of French infectious-diseases and public-health researchers argues that the island’s experience, despite some of the most intensive outbreak surveillance anywhere in the region, exposes gaps that other territories increasingly exposed to mosquito-borne viruses cannot afford to ignore. The authors draw three central lessons from the epidemic: the challenge of translating surveillance signals into operational response, the pressure that surging case numbers placed on primary care, and the complexity of deploying a newly authorized vaccine in the middle of an ongoing epidemic. The chronology of the outbreak is central to the analysis. The first autochthonous chikungunya cases, meaning locally acquired infections rather than imported ones, were detected on 23 August 2024. Local transmission then progressively intensified, and Réunion officially entered the epidemic phase on 13 January 2025. After several months of sustained transmission, declining epidemiological indicators led the prefect of Réunion, on the recommendation of the Regional Health Agency (ARS), to return the ORSEC arbovirus response plan to level 2 on 27 June 2025, formally marking the end of the epidemic phase. Even then, low-level viral circulation persisted on the island after the official phase had ended. Discover more infection Get Health Tips health The burden of the epidemic was substantial. It resulted in 54,250 laboratory-confirmed cases, an estimated 195,800 chikungunya-related primary-care consultations, and nearly 3,000 emergency-department visits. Preliminary hospital and Santé publique France surveillance data, which the authors note are still being consolidated, indicate approximately 1,200 hospitalizations and 45 deaths. A post-epidemic serosurvey estimated overall chikungunya virus seroprevalence at 66.0 percent, of which approximately 46 percentage points were estimated to be attributable to the 2025 epidemic after accounting for residual immunity from the 2005–2006 epidemic that also struck the island. A population-weighted survey conducted at the end of the epidemic estimated a symptomatic attack rate of approximately 44 percent, with marked geographical heterogeneity across the island. Discover more Check Symptoms Track Outbreaks Donate to Research public-health The serosurvey also addressed a question that often arises during epidemics: whether some age groups are disproportionately infected. Although recent infection varied across age groups in unadjusted analyses, age was not independently associated with infection after adjustment. In other words, once other factors were accounted for, being older or younger did not by itself determine the likelihood of infection. This distinction between crude, unadjusted patterns and adjusted analytical findings is one the authors take care to preserve, and it matters for anyone interpreting who was actually at greatest risk of acquiring the virus during this outbreak. What made Réunion unusual was not only the size of the epidemic but the density of monitoring surrounding it. The outbreak was tracked through complementary systems combining laboratory-confirmed case reporting, primary-care and hospital surveillance, virological characterization of the circulating virus, vector surveillance, serological investigations and, once vaccination began, pharmacovigilance. Epidemiological and healthcare indicators were monitored in near real time during the epidemic, while population-level immunity was assessed afterwards through a dedicated post-epidemic serosurvey. This layered architecture allowed early detection of autochthonous transmission in August 2024, rapid characterization of the circulating chikungunya virus lineage, and close tracking of epidemic dynamics as they unfolded. Yet the first lesson the authors draw is a sobering one about the limits of detection. Integrated epidemiological and virological surveillance worked as designed, identifying local transmission early and characterizing the virus quickly. However, the subsequent acceleration of transmission illustrates that interventions requiring substantial operational preparation, including vaccination, may be difficult to deploy rapidly once epidemic growth has begun. The authors are careful about what this does and does not show: rather than demonstrating a generalized delay in the response, the epidemic timeline highlights the importance of defining response strategies, decision thresholds and operational mechanisms before epidemic escalation, so that they can be activated rather than constructed while case numbers climb. The second lesson concerns healthcare capacity. Around the epidemic peak, chikungunya-related consultations accounted for 18 percent of total general-practitioner activity, with an estimated 20,520 consultations for clinically compatible chikungunya cases in epidemiological week 15 alone. The authors note that the effect of this increased demand on access to care for other conditions was not quantitatively assessed, an important limitation, but they argue that these observations nonetheless demonstrate why primary-care surge capacity must be incorporated into arbovirus preparedness plans. Discover more Public Health public health Study Biology infectious-diseases infections The third lesson is the most cautionary. The free IXCHIQ vaccination campaign began on 7 April 2025, initially targeting individuals at highest risk of severe disease, including adults aged 65 years and older, particularly those with comorbidities. Approximately 6,400 doses had been administered by late April. Previous acceptability data from Réunion had shown that willingness to receive chikungunya vaccination was strongly context-dependent, particularly on whether vaccination was provided free of charge, a finding the authors cite to underline the importance of affordability and delivery conditions when planning emergency vaccine deployment. The safety trajectory of the campaign then unfolded quickly. Following reports of serious adverse events after immunization, French health authorities recommended on 26 April that IXCHIQ should no longer be administered to persons aged 65 years and older. Enhanced pharmacovigilance subsequently identified 47 reported adverse-event cases, including 18 serious cases and three deaths. Pharmacological assessment supported an association with IXCHIQ in 9 of the 18 serious cases, while an association was considered very likely for one of the three deaths. Similar safety concerns, particularly serious neurological and cardiac events in older adults, were also identified through post-authorization surveillance in the United States. For the authors, these events illustrate the importance of anticipating pharmacovigilance, benefit–risk reassessment and communication strategies before, not after, a newly authorized vaccine is deployed during an epidemic. The Commentary is explicit that Réunion should not be treated as a direct epidemiological model for mainland Europe. The island combines established Aedes albopictus mosquito populations with tropical climatic conditions that can sustain transmission over a prolonged period, whereas chikungunya transmission in mainland Europe remains strongly seasonal and dependent on the introduction of viraemic cases into areas where competent vectors are active. Population immunity, geography and healthcare organization also differ substantially between settings. Nevertheless, the authors argue that the operational lessons travel well: translating surveillance signals into predefined response thresholds, anticipating healthcare surge capacity, preparing vaccine deployment and pharmacovigilance mechanisms in advance, ensuring rapid data sharing, and embedding research within outbreak response. These preparedness principles may be relevant beyond Réunion, but their implementation must be adapted to local epidemiological and health-system contexts. The conclusions the authors reach are deliberately operational rather than dramatic. Effective preparedness, they write, requires more than early detection. Surveillance signals need to be linked to predefined escalation thresholds and operational response mechanisms; primary-care and hospital surge capacity should be anticipated; and vaccine-deployment strategies, including logistics, pharmacovigilance, benefit–risk reassessment and communication, should be established before epidemic acceleration. Timely data sharing across epidemiological, virological and healthcare surveillance systems is essential, while clinical and vaccine-effectiveness studies should be designed for rapid activation and embedded within the outbreak response itself. For regions increasingly exposed to chikungunya, the Réunion experience suggests that preparedness depends not only on detecting the next outbreak early, but on having the mechanisms in place to act on that information rapidly. As chikungunya transmission now occurs in new areas of Europe, the island stands as a sentinel at the crossroads of intense regional mobility, climate-driven vector expansion and increasing arboviral emergence. analysis.time: The epidemic began with the first autochthonous cases detected on 23 August 2024, and the official epidemic phase ended on 27 June 2025. The publication date of the article is 3 November 2026.
analysis.location_and_population: Réunion Island, France. The epidemic affected the entire population, with a post-epidemic serosurvey estimating a 66.0 percent seroprevalence rate, and a symptomatic attack rate of approximately 44 percent.
analysis.event: A chikungunya epidemic occurred on Réunion Island from 2024 to 2025, with 54,250 laboratory-confirmed cases, 195,800 primary-care consultations, and nearly 3,000 emergency-department visits. The authors of a Commentary in Archives of Public Health analyzed the epidemic's impact and lessons for public health preparedness.
analysis.scale_impact_and_risk: The epidemic resulted in 54,250 confirmed cases, 195,800 chikungunya-related primary-care consultations, and nearly 3,000 emergency-department visits. Preliminary data indicated approximately 1,200 hospitalizations and 45 deaths. The authors note that the epidemic's scale and the associated healthcare burden highlight the need for surge capacity in primary care.
analysis.response_status_and_uncertainty: The epidemic was officially declared over on 27 June 2025, but low-level viral circulation persisted. A free vaccination campaign began on 7 April 2025, but safety concerns led to its suspension for older adults on 26 April 2025. The authors emphasize the importance of pre-epidemic planning for vaccine deployment and pharmacovigilance.

analysis.brief_en: The article discusses the 2024–2025 chikungunya epidemic on Réunion Island, highlighting its documented impact and lessons for public health preparedness in Europe. The first autochthonous cases were detected on 23 August 2024, and the epidemic officially ended on 27 June 2025, though low-level circulation continued. The outbreak led to 54,250 laboratory-confirmed cases, 195,800 primary-care consultations, and nearly 3,000 emergency-department visits. Preliminary data suggested 1,200 hospitalizations and 45 deaths. The authors of a Commentary in Archives of Public Health note that the epidemic's monitoring systems, including virological and vector surveillance, were robust but revealed gaps in operational response. They emphasize the need for pre-defined strategies and surge capacity in primary care. A free vaccination campaign started in April 2025 but was halted for older adults due to safety concerns, with 47 adverse-event cases reported, including 18 serious cases and three deaths. The authors caution against treating Réunion as a direct model for mainland Europe, citing differences in population immunity, geography, and healthcare systems.

Preliminary data suggested 1,200 hospitalizations and 45 deaths. They emphasize the need for pre-defined strategies and surge capacity in primary care. A free vaccination campaign started in April 2025 but was halted for older adults due to safety concerns, with 47 adverse-event cases reported, including 18 serious cases and three deaths. news.source_body_en: The article discusses the 2024–2025 chikungunya epidemic on Réunion Island, highlighting its documented impact and lessons for public health preparedness in Europe. The first autochthonous cases were detected on 23 August 2024, and the epidemic officially ended on 27 June 2025, though low-level circulation continued. The outbreak led to 54,250 laboratory-confirmed cases, 195,800 primary-care consultations, and nearly 3,000 emergency-department visits. Preliminary data suggested 1,200 hospitalizations and 45 deaths. The authors of a Commentary in Archives of Public Health note that the epidemic's monitoring systems, including virological and vector surveillance, were robust but revealed gaps in operational response. They emphasize the need for pre-defined strategies and surge capacity in primary care. A free vaccination campaign started in April 2025 but was halted for older adults due to safety concerns, with 47 adverse-event cases reported, including 18 serious cases and three deaths. The authors caution against treating Réunion as a direct model for mainland Europe, citing differences in population immunity, geography, and healthcare systems.
news.content_zh: 本文讨论了 2024 年至 2025 年留尼汪岛的基孔肯雅热疫情,强调了其记录在案的影响以及对欧洲公共卫生准备的教训。2024年8月23日发现第一例本土病例,疫情于2025年6月27日正式结束,但低水平循环仍在继续。暴发 导致 54,250 例实验室确诊病例、195,800 次初级保健咨询和近 3,000 次急诊科就诊。初步数据显示,有 1,200 人住院治疗,45 人死亡。《公共卫生档案》评论的作者指出,该流行病的监测系统(包括病毒学监测系统和 媒介 监测 系统)十分健全,但在操作响应方面却暴露出差距。他们强调初级保健需要预先确定的策略和激增的能力。一项针对老年人的免费 疫苗接种 活动于 2025 年 4 月开始,但出于安全考虑而停止,该活动已报告 47 起不良事件病例,其中 18 例严重病例和 3 例死亡。作者警告不要将留尼汪岛视为欧洲大陆的直接模式,理由是人口免疫力、地理和医疗保健系统存在差异。

news.content: HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER Tuesday, November 3, 2026 No Result View All Result Login HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER HOME NEWS EXPLORE CAREER Companies Jobs Lecturer PhD Studentship Postdoc Research Assistant EVENTS iGEM News Team PHOTOS VIDEO WIKI BLOG COMMUNITY FACEBOOK INSTAGRAM TWITTER No Result View All Result No Result View All Result Home NEWS Science News Technology New framework tracks public opinion shifts during a Chikungunya outbreak on Weibo by October 28, 2026 in Technology Reading Time: 3 mins read 0 New framework tracks public opinion shifts during a Chikungunya outbreak on Weibo Share on FacebookShare on TwitterShare on LinkedinShare on RedditShare on Telegram Researchers have introduced a dual-level framework that couples event knowledge graphs with a topic modeling approach to follow how public opinion evolves on social media during public health emergencies. The work, published in EPJ Data Science, was applied to 22,744 Weibo posts related to the Chikungunya fever outbreak. The framework addresses two persistent problems in social media monitoring: the semantic noise that arises when analyzing very short texts, and the fragmented way in which discourse structures and user behavior have typically been studied separately. The authors combine Event Knowledge Graphs (EKG) with user behavior profiling, both built on a Centroid-Alignment Factor (C-AF) embedding-enhanced BERTopic model. When applied to the Weibo corpus, the C-AF model improved Topic Diversity from 0.5725 to 0.6480. According to the study, this optimization enabled the construction of a high-precision event knowledge graph that reveals core discourse evolutionary pathways, showing how conversation themes shifted as the outbreak unfolded. Discover more Check Symptoms Track Outbreaks public health Public Health For user behavior segmentation, the framework achieved a peak Silhouette Coefficient of 0.909, which the authors report as outperforming the 0.670 baseline by 35.7 percent. An external semantic indicator, Topic Coherence, also improved from 0.550 to 0.783, providing a second line of validation for the clustering results. This dual validation allowed the researchers to identify five distinct user profiles among the accounts posting about the outbreak: Early Cognitive, Knowledge Dissemination, Risk-Attention, Prevention-Focused, and Preventive Alert types. Each profile represents a different pattern of information behavior, from early awareness of the event to active dissemination of knowledge and attention to preventive measures. The authors position the framework as a scalable, data-driven tool for precise public health crisis monitoring and targeted digital governance intervention. By linking what people are talking about with how different groups of users behave, the approach aims to give authorities a more granular picture of public sentiment during an emergency than topic modeling alone can provide. The study is published as open access research in EPJ Data Science, with the article shared early to provide faster access to peer-reviewed, accepted research; the published version is subject to further edits and will be replaced by the final Version of Record. The article was published on 9 October 2026 and is authored by Juan Wang, Xianghui Kong and Xiaojing Zhang. Discover more Try Microblogs opinion Read News Blogs Knowledge Graphs knowledge graphs Because the framework was developed and tested on a single dataset of Weibo posts about one outbreak, its performance on other platforms, languages, and public health events remains to be demonstrated. The reported metrics describe model performance on this corpus rather than outcomes of any intervention deployed in the field, and the identified user profiles characterize posting behavior within this specific dataset. Subject of Research: A topic modeling and event knowledge graph framework for tracking public opinion and user behavior on social media during a public health emergency. news.title_zh: 新框架在微博上追踪基孔肯雅热 暴发 期间的公众舆论变化 - Bioengineer.org
news.source_body_en: A new framework, introduced by researchers at Bioengineer.org, tracks public opinion shifts during a Chikungunya fever outbreak on Weibo. The framework couples event knowledge graphs with a topic modeling approach, using a Centroid-Alignment Factor (C-AF) embedding-enhanced BERTopic model. It was applied to 22,744 Weibo posts related to the outbreak, improving Topic Diversity from 0.5725 to 0.6480 and achieving a peak Silhouette Coefficient of 0.909, which outperforms the baseline by 35.7 percent. The study, published on 9 October 2026, identifies five distinct user profiles based on their posting behavior during the outbreak. However, the framework's performance on other platforms, languages, and public health events remains untested. The research is open access and aims to provide a scalable, data-driven tool for public health crisis monitoring and targeted digital governance intervention.

news.content_title: 登革热VS基孔肯雅热:症状对比、传播途径和预防措施
news.content: 所谓“蚊媒传染病”,就是蚊子在叮咬时把病毒或寄生虫“快递”到人体内的疾病;国内需要重点盯防的有登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒病、乙型脑炎和疟疾等。 今天,我们先锁定由伊蚊 “ 投递 ” 的两大热门 疾病 —— 登革热与基孔肯雅热。 图源:云南疾控 0 1 什么是登革热? 它是由登革病毒引起的,经伊蚊叮咬传播的虫媒传染病。据世界卫生组织统计,全球每年约有1-4亿人感染,其中美洲、东南亚和西太平洋区域发病最为严重,亚洲约占全球疾病负担的70%。我国广东、云南、广西等多个省份曾多次发生本地疫情。 展开全文 0 2 登革热的典型症状有哪些? 登革热的潜伏期(从被携带病毒的蚊子叮咬到症状开始的时间)一般为1-14天,多为5-9天。值得注意的是大多数感染者没有症状或症状轻微,不过,一旦发病,患者会出现一系列典型症状: 1.突发高热: 体温可达40°C以上; 2.“三痛”: 剧烈头痛、眼眶痛、全身肌肉关节痛; 3.“三红”: 面部、颈部、胸部潮红; 4.皮疹: 四肢或躯干出现充血性红疹; 5.消化道症状: 恶心、呕吐、腹泻、食欲不振等消化道症状; 6.严重者: 可发展为登革出血热或登革休克综合征,甚至危及生命。 0 3 什么是基孔肯雅热? 基孔肯雅热(Chikungunya fever)是一种由基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)引起,通过白纹伊蚊或埃及伊蚊传播的病毒性疾病。 基孔肯雅热始发于非洲,最早于1952年在坦桑尼亚首次被发现。 “基孔肯雅”一词就来源于坦桑尼亚南部 基马孔德语 ,意思是“变得扭曲”,用以描述出现严重关节疼痛的感染者痛得弯腰、蜷缩身体的样子。 根据世界卫生组织公布的最新数据,截至2024年12月,全球119个国家和地区已报告基孔肯雅热本地传播。 近些年我国周边的东南亚疫情持续活跃。我国于2008年首次发现输入性病例,曾引发本地疫情,但尚未形成稳定的疫源地。2025年7月广东省佛山市发生疫情,经全力防控,现疫情已呈明显下降趋势。 0 4 基孔肯雅热有何症状? 被带 基孔肯雅 病毒的蚊子叮咬后,病毒在体内潜伏期通常为3-7天(最短1天,最长可达12天),随后可能突然发病,出现典型的“热-疹-痛”三联征: 🔺 突发高烧: 体温可高达39°C以上,可能持续1-7天。部分患者会出现“双峰热”,即退烧后再次发热。 🔺 皮疹: 约80%的患者在发热后2-5天,面部、四肢甚至手掌脚底会出现红色斑疹或丘疹,常伴有瘙痒。 🔺 明显关节疼痛: 这是基孔肯雅热最突出的特点之一。特别是手指、手腕、脚踝和脚趾等小关节会出现剧烈疼痛和肿胀,可能持续数天甚至数月。 此外,还可能伴随头痛、恶心、呕吐、肌肉痛、结膜炎等症状。 0 5 这两种疾病有什么区别? 这两种疾病,各年龄人群普遍易感,发病初期都会出现高热、头痛、关节和肌肉疼痛等症状。 登革热发生重症的比例较高, 致死病例时有发生。 基孔肯雅热多数患者为轻症 ,大约会在1~2周内康复,但部分人(尤其是老年人和慢性病患者)可能会经历长期关节疼痛的折磨;只有极少数情况下,该病会导致出血、脑炎等严重并发症甚至死亡。 两种疾病的特征对比 在登革热和基孔肯雅热共同流行的地区,常有人同时感染两种病毒。 0 6 这两种疾病是如何传播的? 登革热和基孔肯雅热的传播途径相似,都是由白纹伊蚊和埃及伊蚊传播。伊蚊白天叮咬人,尤其活跃于日出后1-2小时和日落前2-3小时。它们的幼虫孳生于小型积水容器中,如瓶罐、废旧轮胎、花盆等,这些地方都可能成为它们的“温床”。 0 7 如何预防这两种疾病? 面对蚊媒传染病的威胁,我们可以通过科学有效的预防措施,降低被其感染的风险: 1.环境治理: 伊蚊依赖小型积水繁殖,因此清除蚊虫孳生地是预防虫媒传染病的根本措施。我们需要定时清理家中容易积水的地方,如瓶罐、废旧轮胎、花盆、下水道、杂物堆等区域,不给蚊子提供繁殖的机会。 2.个人防护: 外出时,尽量穿浅色长袖衣裤,减少皮肤暴露面积;同时在裸露皮肤上涂抹含避蚊胺、避蚊酯的驱蚊液。在家中,安装纱门纱窗,使用蚊帐,为自己打造一个安全的“无蚊空间”;必要时使用电蚊拍、灭蚊灯等,对蚊子进行“精准打击”。此外,尽量减少在户外树阴、草丛等蚊子多的地方逗留时间。 返回搜狐,查看更多

news.content_original: 所谓“蚊媒传染病”,就是蚊子在叮咬时把病毒或寄生虫“快递”到人体内的疾病;国内需要重点盯防的有登革热、基孔肯雅热、寨卡病毒病、乙型脑炎和疟疾等。 今天,我们先锁定由伊蚊 “ 投递 ” 的两大热门 疾病 —— 登革热与基孔肯雅热。 图源:云南疾控 0 1 什么是登革热? 它是由登革病毒引起的,经伊蚊叮咬传播的虫媒传染病。据世界卫生组织统计,全球每年约有1-4亿人感染,其中美洲、东南亚和西太平洋区域发病最为严重,亚洲约占全球疾病负担的70%。我国广东、云南、广西等多个省份曾多次发生本地疫情。 展开全文 0 2 登革热的典型症状有哪些? 登革热的潜伏期(从被携带病毒的蚊子叮咬到症状开始的时间)一般为1-14天,多为5-9天。值得注意的是大多数感染者没有症状或症状轻微,不过,一旦发病,患者会出现一系列典型症状: 1.突发高热: 体温可达40°C以上; 2.“三痛”: 剧烈头痛、眼眶痛、全身肌肉关节痛; 3.“三红”: 面部、颈部、胸部潮红; 4.皮疹: 四肢或躯干出现充血性红疹; 5.消化道症状: 恶心、呕吐、腹泻、食欲不振等消化道症状; 6.严重者: 可发展为登革出血热或登革休克综合征,甚至危及生命。 0 3 什么是基孔肯雅热? 基孔肯雅热(Chikungunya fever)是一种由基孔肯雅病毒(CHIKV)引起,通过白纹伊蚊或埃及伊蚊传播的病毒性疾病。 基孔肯雅热始发于非洲,最早于1952年在坦桑尼亚首次被发现。 “基孔肯雅”一词就来源于坦桑尼亚南部 基马孔德语 ,意思是“变得扭曲”,用以描述出现严重关节疼痛的感染者痛得弯腰、蜷缩身体的样子。 根据世界卫生组织公布的最新数据,截至2024年12月,全球119个国家和地区已报告基孔肯雅热本地传播。 近些年我国周边的东南亚疫情持续活跃。我国于2008年首次发现输入性病例,曾引发本地疫情,但尚未形成稳定的疫源地。2025年7月广东省佛山市发生疫情,经全力防控,现疫情已呈明显下降趋势。 0 4 基孔肯雅热有何症状? 被带 基孔肯雅 病毒的蚊子叮咬后,病毒在体内潜伏期通常为3-7天(最短1天,最长可达12天),随后可能突然发病,出现典型的“热-疹-痛”三联征: 🔺 突发高烧: 体温可高达39°C以上,可能持续1-7天。部分患者会出现“双峰热”,即退烧后再次发热。 🔺 皮疹: 约80%的患者在发热后2-5天,面部、四肢甚至手掌脚底会出现红色斑疹或丘疹,常伴有瘙痒。 🔺 明显关节疼痛: 这是基孔肯雅热最突出的特点之一。特别是手指、手腕、脚踝和脚趾等小关节会出现剧烈疼痛和肿胀,可能持续数天甚至数月。 此外,还可能伴随头痛、恶心、呕吐、肌肉痛、结膜炎等症状。 0 5 这两种疾病有什么区别? 这两种疾病,各年龄人群普遍易感,发病初期都会出现高热、头痛、关节和肌肉疼痛等症状。 登革热发生重症的比例较高, 致死病例时有发生。 基孔肯雅热多数患者为轻症 ,大约会在1~2周内康复,但部分人(尤其是老年人和慢性病患者)可能会经历长期关节疼痛的折磨;只有极少数情况下,该病会导致出血、脑炎等严重并发症甚至死亡。 两种疾病的特征对比 在登革热和基孔肯雅热共同流行的地区,常有人同时感染两种病毒。 0 6 这两种疾病是如何传播的? 登革热和基孔肯雅热的传播途径相似,都是由白纹伊蚊和埃及伊蚊传播。伊蚊白天叮咬人,尤其活跃于日出后1-2小时和日落前2-3小时。它们的幼虫孳生于小型积水容器中,如瓶罐、废旧轮胎、花盆等,这些地方都可能成为它们的“温床”。 0 7 如何预防这两种疾病? 面对蚊媒传染病的威胁,我们可以通过科学有效的预防措施,降低被其感染的风险: 1.环境治理: 伊蚊依赖小型积水繁殖,因此清除蚊虫孳生地是预防虫媒传染病的根本措施。我们需要定时清理家中容易积水的地方,如瓶罐、废旧轮胎、花盆、下水道、杂物堆等区域,不给蚊子提供繁殖的机会。 2.个人防护: 外出时,尽量穿浅色长袖衣裤,减少皮肤暴露面积;同时在裸露皮肤上涂抹含避蚊胺、避蚊酯的驱蚊液。在家中,安装纱门纱窗,使用蚊帐,为自己打造一个安全的“无蚊空间”;必要时使用电蚊拍、灭蚊灯等,对蚊子进行“精准打击”。此外,尽量减少在户外树阴、草丛等蚊子多的地方逗留时间。 返回搜狐,查看更多
